**Brief On The Organization**
 The Public Health Foundation of India (PHFI) is working towards building a healthier India. It is helping to address the limited institutional and systems capacity in India by strengthening education and training, advancing research and technology and facilitating policy and practice in the area of Public Health. PHFI is headquartered in New Delhi with national presence through its constituent units of regional Indian Institutes of Public Health (IIPHs) and Centers of Applied Research in core public health themes. The Foundation, established in 2006 as a public private initiative, is governed by an independent board comprising of senior government officials, eminent Indian and International academic and leaders, civil society representatives and corporate leaders. For more information, please visit the website w
 **ww.phfi.org** 
 .
   

  

**Project Brief**
 The Public Health Foundation of India (PHFI) serves as a Sub\-Recipient (SR) under the Global Fund to Fight AIDS, Tuberculosis and Malaria (GFATM) for the period April 2024 to March 2027, to implement key capacity\-building initiatives under the National AIDS Control Program Phase V (NACP\-V). The project officially commenced on May 1, 2024\. PHFI is responsible for implementing activities under three major components:
   

  

* SR Activity Management HUB
* Capacity Building – Central Region
* Capacity Building – North Region


 As the SR for the SR Activity Management HUB, PHFI will manage and coordinate sub\-recipient activities and provide institutionalized oversight and technical support. This includes performance monitoring, financial management, risk mitigation, and facilitating capacity\-building interventions. The HUB plays a critical role in ensuring horizontal integration at the SACS and NACO levels and acts as a central technical agency for strengthening community systems (CSS), DISHA, and community\-led monitoring (CLM).
   

  

 In the Central and North Regions, PHFI will directly implement capacity\-building activities in line with the project agreement and work plans. These include training, technical assistance, and supportive supervision aimed at enhancing service delivery in HIV prevention, care, and support. The SR ensures effective resource management, collaboration with the Principal Recipient (PR) and stakeholders, and alignment of programmatic goals across all implementation sites.
   

  

 PHFI’s role across these three components emphasizes accountability, technical excellence, and a coordinated approach to achieving the goals of the HIV program under GFATM.
   

  

**Job Summary**
 The Associate Coordinator (Capacity Building Unit) supports the planning, coordination, implementation, and monitoring capacity\-building initiatives under the National AIDS Control Program (NACP) and other public health projects. The Associate Coordinator will also assist in monitoring project progress, facilitating communication among stakeholders, contributing to data analysis and report reporting.
   

  

**Deliverables**

description:
**About the Think Tank:** 
 Chintan Research Foundation (CRF) is a non\-profit public policy organization based in New Delhi. **Key Responsibilities:** 




 • Collect and analyze data from various sources to support research initiatives related to economic and trade policies, industry trends, global economic forecasts. • Conduct in\-depth research and data analysis for the focus areas. • Contribute to the creation of research reports, policy papers, and articles of the highest quality and relevance. • Organize, manage, and document research materials to support ongoing projects at CRF. • Provide logistical and administrative support for events, seminars, and workshops.
 



  





**Qualifications and Skills:** 




 • Master’s degree, preferably in Economics, International Trade, Public Policy or a related field. • Understanding of current policy debates concerning economics and trade at both national and international levels. • Strong research and analytical skills with attention to detail. • Excellent written and verbal communication skills. • Proficiency in data analysis tools and research software. • Proficiency in MS Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint). • Ability to work as part of a team as well as on own initiative. • Ability to work in a fast\-paced environment. • Strong interpersonal skills and team ethics.

title: Computer Engineering Expert - AI Content Specialist
description:
* Location: Remote


**About The Job**
 At Alignerr, we partner with the world’s leading AI research teams and labs to build and train cutting\-edge AI models.
   

  

 You’ll challenge advanced language models on topics like computer architecture and hardware design, embedded systems and IoT, networking and distributed systems, hardware security, and systems software and operating systems—documenting every failure mode so we can harden model reasoning.
   

  

**Organization** 
 : Alignerr
 **Position** 
 : Computer Engineering Expert \- AI Content Specialist
 **Type** 
 : Hourly Contract
 **Compensation** 
 : $35–$60 /hour
 **Location** 
 : Remote
 **Commitment** 
 : 10–40 hours/week
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
* Develop Complex Problems: Design advanced computer engineering challenges across domains like RISC\-V/ARM architecture, FPGA development, memory management, and hardware\-software co\-design.
* Author Ground\-Truth Solutions: Create rigorous, step\-by\-step technical solutions, including assembly code, hardware description language (HDL) snippets, and architectural diagrams that serve as "golden responses" for AI training.
* Technical Auditing: Evaluate AI\-generated code (C/C\+\+, Verilog, VHDL), logic gate designs, and operating system kernels for technical accuracy, efficiency, and adherence to industry standards.
* Refine Reasoning: Identify logical fallacies in AI reasoning—such as race conditions, memory leaks, or improper timing constraints—and provide structured feedback to improve the model's "thinking" process.


**Requirements**
* Advanced Degree: Masters (pursuing or completed) or PhD in Computer Engineering, Computer Science with a hardware focus, or a closely related field.
* Domain Expertise: Strong foundational knowledge in core areas such as Computer Architecture, Embedded Systems, Digital Logic Design, or Operating Systems.

**A strong understanding of the built environment** 




**Yo** 
 u should come from one of these or a closely related background:
 


* Architecture
* Civil Engineering
* Structural Engineering
* MEP
* Construction
* Design \& Technology
* Other Built Environment discipline



  





 You don't need to be an expert in every area.
 



 What matters is that you understand the world of AEC and are curious about how it is changing.

* Is curious and asks thoughtful questions.

 You'll bring your understanding of AEC and BIM into learning, research, program execution and problem\-solving, while getting a much broader view of the industry and the people shaping its future.
 



  





**What you'll work on:** 




**Build better learning experiences** 



* Work with mentors and internal teams to create assignments, activities, resources and other learning materials.
* Help translate technical and industry concepts into learning experiences that are clear and useful for professionals.
* Contribute to curriculum structuring, presentations and documentation.
* Review and improve learning experiences based on learner feedback and industry needs.



  





**Stay close to where AEC is heading** 



* Research how AEC teams are working today and how those workflows are evolving.
* Explore emerging technologies, tools and approaches that could influence the industry.
* Bring relevant industry observations and ideas into our programs.
* Help us experiment with better ways of teaching and delivering programs.



  





**Work closely with people** 



* Collaborate with industry mentors and professionals to bring real\-world context into our programs.
* Interact with learners and understand the challenges they face.
* Coordinate with internal teams to keep programs moving smoothly.
* Help resolve learner and program\-related challenges with ownership.



  





**Own program execution** 



* Support the end\-to\-end execution of learning programs.
* Track milestones, deliverables and timelines.
* Coordinate across mentors, learners and internal teams.
* Identify gaps, solve problems and improve processes along the way.



  





**What you must bring:** 




**A strong foundation in BIM** 




 You should have genuine, hands\-on familiarity with:
 


* BIM workflows
* Revit
* Navisworks



 You don't need to know everything about BIM. We care more about whether you understand how these tools and workflows are actually used and can apply that understanding thoughtfully.
 



  





**How you think and work:** 




**We're looking for someone who** 



* Takes ownership rather than waiting to be told what to do.
* Is curious about how the AEC industry is changing.
* Can break down a problem and figure out a way forward.
* Communicates clearly with different kinds of people.
* Is comfortable researching, learning, and working with incomplete information.
* Can manage multiple priorities without losing attention to detail.
* Enjoys building things, improving processes, and making things work better.



  





**Good to have:** 




**These aren't requirements, but they would be a great addition:** 



* Experience with Civil 3D
* Experience with ETABS
* Experience with STAAD.Pro
* Exposure to BIM coordination
* Understanding of construction documentation
* Experience working on real\-world AEC projects
* Experience creating presentations, documentation, or learning content
* Exposure to AI or productivity tools
* Experience coordinating projects, teams or stakeholders



  





**Who could be a great fit?** 




 You could be an architect, civil engineer, structural engineer, or someone from a related built\-environment background.
 



  





 You may have spent your career working on projects and are now curious about what lies beyond the traditional project role.
 



  





 Or you may be earlier in your career and already have a strong foundation in BIM, along with the curiosity to understand the industry beyond the software you use.
 



  





 We're not looking for someone who checks every box.
 



  





 We're looking for someone who can bring their AEC perspective, learn quickly, take ownership, and help us build something that didn't exist in the same way when we were students.
 



  





**What you'll gain:** 



* Exposure to real\-world AEC workflows and the people shaping them.
* Hands\-on experience in program and project execution.
* The opportunity to work closely with experienced AEC mentors and professionals.
* Exposure across learning, content, operations, product, and industry partnerships.
* Experience building systems and processes in a fast\-moving startup environment.
* A chance to contribute to how the next generation of AEC professionals prepares for the industry.

title: Consultant - TB Diagnostics Expert, Infectious Disease – Tuberculosis
description:
PATH current employees \- please log in and apply
 **Here**
 PATH is a global nonprofit dedicated to achieving health equity. With more than 40 years of experience forging multisector partnerships and with expertise in science, economics, technology, advocacy, and dozens of other specialties, PATH develops and scales up innovative solutions to the world’s most pressing health challenges.
   

  

**About the Project: REACH Bangladesh**
 REACH Bangladesh — Integrated Molecular Diagnostics, Laboratory Systems Strengthening, Emergency Preparedness, and Integrated Laboratory Response Systems — is funded by the U.S. Department of State, Bureau of Global Health Security and Diplomacy (GHSD), and implemented by PATH. The award is a fixed amount award issued under the America First Global Health Strategy to ensure continuity of lifesaving health assistance and to support integrated, country\-led health systems programming, with an anticipated implementation period of approximately 10–12 months.
   

  

 Bangladesh continues to face a significant burden of tuberculosis and other priority infectious diseases, compounded by fragmented laboratory networks, limited decentralized diagnostic access, and gaps in emergency and outbreak\-response readiness at sub\-national levels. PATH will implement the Bangladesh component in close collaboration with the Government of Bangladesh — the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare, the National Tuberculosis Programme (NTP), the Directorate General of Health Services (DGHS), and divisional and district health authorities — with BRAC and icddr,b as potential implementing and research partners. Coverage spans 30 districts across seven geographic clusters, alongside national and divisional coordination.
   

  

 The project is organized around three strategic priority areas: (1\) integrated molecular diagnostics and laboratory network strengthening; (2\) laboratory quality, biosafety and workforce excellence; and (3\) emergency preparedness and laboratory resilience — each delivered at national, regional, and district levels and supported by strengthened data systems, MIS, coordination, and learning.
   

  

**PATH is hiring a Consultant – TB Diagnostics Expert, based in India.**
 The Consultant – TB Diagnostics Expert, under the overall supervision of the Deputy Director – TB, South Asia, PATH, and in close coordination with the PATH Bangladesh country team and project leadership, will provide technical oversight and undertake preparatory and inception\-phase activities for the diagnostics, laboratory systems, and emergency preparedness workstreams of REACH Bangladesh. The consultant will bring regional expertise in molecular diagnostics, laboratory network optimization, quality assurance, and biosafety to support rapid start\-up, co\-design with government and donor stakeholders, and the development of technical packages, SOPs, and monitoring frameworks required for implementation.
   

  

**Specific Roles of this Position include\-**
* Provide technical oversight to the REACH Bangladesh diagnostics and laboratory workstreams, and support PATH teams and potential sub\-awardees in translating the co\-design workshop outputs into an approved inception workplan, staffing plan, implementation schedule, and coordination plan.
* Support preparatory work for updating the national laboratory network optimization plan for integrated HIV, TB and priority infectious diseases, and for developing an integrated molecular testing strategy leveraging existing GeneXpert, Truenat, and RT\-PCR platforms.
* Contribute technical inputs to the national roadmap for novel screening and diagnostic tools for TB — including CAD/AI\-assisted handheld X\-ray, N\-PoC, CRISPR, and repurposing of molecular infrastructure — and to the design of a tiered laboratory network defining testing menus and referral pathways.
* Guide preparatory design of decentralized molecular testing, district specimen collection hubs, specimen referral and transportation networks, QR\-code\-enabled sample referral tracking, electronic specimen tracking, and turnaround\-time monitoring, including outreach testing for hard\-to\-reach populations.
* Support development of the national laboratory quality improvement roadmap, updated biosafety guidelines, expansion of External Quality Assessment to peripheral facilities, competency frameworks, certification and leadership programmes, laboratory performance scorecards, and QA process indicators.
* Provide technical oversight for preparatory activities under emergency preparedness and laboratory resilience, including the integrated emergency laboratory preparedness plan, One Health laboratory coordination, harmonized SOPs and referral protocols, laboratory surge planning, rapid response laboratory teams, and simulation and tabletop exercise designs.
* Support integration of TB–DM–HIV testing pathways and alignment of diagnostic protocols with national algorithms and NTP/DGHS guidance.
* Provide technical inputs to MIS, dashboards, data quality assurance, and performance monitoring frameworks for diagnostic and laboratory indicators, including turnaround time, referral pathway performance, and quality improvement indicators.
* Support preparation for co\-creation and coordination engagements with the U.S. Embassy Dhaka, Government of Bangladesh counterparts, technical working groups, and partners, including preparation of agendas, technical briefs, presentations, and workshop documentation.
* Undertake travel to Bangladesh and within the region (approximately 20–30% of time) for co\-design workshops, stakeholder consultations, laboratory assessments, and technical review meetings, as required.
* Prepare periodic progress updates and document technical products, best practices, and lessons learned for internal and external sharing, in line with donor branding, reporting, and milestone verification requirements.
* Perform any other project\-related tasks assigned by the supervisor.


**Qualifications And Competencies Required**
* PhD or postgraduate degree in Public Health, Microbiology, Laboratory Sciences, Health Administration, or an equivalent discipline from a recognized university.
* Minimum 10 years of experience in public health programmes, of which at least 5 years should be in TB or infectious disease diagnostics, laboratory systems strengthening, or diagnostic network management at national or state/provincial level; regional or international experience preferred.
* Demonstrated expertise in molecular diagnostics (GeneXpert, Truenat, RT\-PCR), laboratory network optimization, specimen referral systems, external quality assessment, biosafety, and laboratory quality management systems.
* Familiarity with national TB diagnostic algorithms, laboratory accreditation and certification frameworks, and emergency preparedness and One Health approaches.
* Experience working with government counterparts, donors, and multi\-partner consortia; prior experience with U.S. Government\-funded programmes and milestone\-based reporting is an added advantage.
* Excellent technical writing skills, with a demonstrated ability to develop strategies, SOPs, guidelines, and donor\-ready technical documents.
* Fluency in English is required; working familiarity with Bangla is an advantage.
* Ability to communicate clearly, mentor, and work collaboratively across geographies and time zones under demanding timelines.


 The position requires travel to Bangladesh and within the region as per project needs. We are looking for a self\-motivated, hard\-working, energetic, and creative individual who is a good team player and is comfortable working in a fast\-paced and evolving environment.
   

  

**Location:** 
 India (Delhi preferred), with travel to Bangladesh
   

  

**Duration:** 
 From the date of joining to August 2027
   

  

**Reporting to:** 
 Deputy Director – TB, South Asia, PATH
   

  

 The candidate must have legal authorization to work in India.

 Greater Delhi Area, India

 Software Development,Telecommunications,IT Services and IT Consulting
   

  

**Job Description**
 About MyOperator
   

  

 MyOperator is a Business AI Operator and category leader that unifies WhatsApp, Calls, and AI\-powered chatbots \& voice bots into one intelligent business communication platform.Unlike fragmented communication tools, MyOperator combines automation, intelligence, and workflow integration to help businesses run WhatsApp campaigns, manage calls, deploy AI chatbots, and track performance — all from a single no\-code platform.Trusted by 12,000\+ brands including Amazon, Domino’s, Apollo, and Razor\-pay, MyOperator enables faster responses, higher resolution rates, and scalable customer engagement
   

  

 Role Summary
   

  

 We’re hiring a Front Deployed Engineer (FDE)—a customer\-facing, field\-deployed engineer who owns the end\-to\-end delivery of AI bots/agents.
   

  

 This role is “frontline”: you’ll work directly with customers (often onsite), translate business reality into bot workflows, do prompt engineering \+ knowledge grounding, ship deployments, and iterate until it works reliably in production.
   

  

 Think: solutions engineer \+ implementation engineer \+ prompt engineer, with a strong bias for execution.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Requirement Discovery \& Stakeholder Interaction


 Join customer calls alongside Sales and Revenue teams.Ask targeted questions to understand business objectives, user journeys, automation expectations, and edge cases.Identify data sources (CRM, APIs, Excel, SharePoint, etc.) required for the solution.Act as the AI subject\-matter expert during client discussions.
   

  

* Use Case \& Solution Documentation


 Convert discussions into clear, structured use case documents, including:Problem statement \& goals.Current vs. proposed conversational flows.Chatbot conversation logic, integrations, and dependencies.Assumptions, limitations, and success criteria.
   

  

* Customer Delivery Ownership


 Own deployment of AI bots for customer use\-cases (lead qualification, support, booking, etc.). Run workshops to capture processes, FAQs, edge cases, and success metrics. Drive the go\-live process: requirements through monitoring and improvement.
   

  

* Prompt Engineering \& Conversation Design


 Craft prompts, tool instructions, guardrails, fallbacks, and escalation policies for stable behavior. Build structured conversational flows: intents, entities, routing, handoff, and compliant responses. Create reusable prompt patterns and "prompt packs."
   

  

* Testing, Debugging \& Iteration


 Analyze logs to find failure modes (misclassification, hallucination, poor handling). Create test sets ("golden conversations"), run regressions, and measure improvements. Coordinate with Product/Engineering for platform needs.
   

  

* Integrations \& Technical Coordination


 Integrate bots with APIs/webhooks (CRM, ticketing, internal tools) to complete workflows. Troubleshoot production issues and coordinate fixes/root\-cause analysis.
   

  

 What Success Looks Like
   

  

 Customer bots go live quickly and show high containment \+ high task completion with low escalation.You can diagnose failures from transcripts/logs and fix them with prompt/workflow/knowledge changes.Customers trust you as the “AI delivery owner”—clear communication, realistic timelines, crisp execution.
   

  

 Requirements (Must Have)
   

  

 2–5 years in customer\-facing delivery roles: implementation, solutions engineering, customer success engineering, or similar.Hands\-on comfort with LLMs and prompt engineering (structured outputs, guardrails, tool use, iteration).Strong communication: workshops, requirement capture, crisp documentation, stakeholder management.Technical fluency: APIs/webhooks concepts, JSON, debugging logs, basic integration troubleshooting.Willingness to be front deployed (customer calls/visits as needed).
   

  

 Good to Have (Nice to Have)
   

  

 Experience with chatbots/voicebots, IVR, WhatsApp automation, conversational AI platforms with at least a couple of projects.Understanding of metrics like containment, resolution rate, response latency, CSAT drivers.Prior SaaS onboarding/delivery experience in mid\-market or enterprises.
   

  

 Working Style \& Traits We Value
   

  

 High agency: you don’t wait for perfect specs—you create clarity and ship.Customer empathy \+ engineering discipline.Strong bias for iteration: deploy → learn → improve.Calm under ambiguity (real customer environments are chaotic by default).

title: Associate- Sustainability(S&R)
description:
**Company Overview**





 Bain \& Company is a global consultancy that helps the world’s most ambitious change\-makers define the future. Across 65 cities in 40 countries, we work alongside our clients as one team with a shared ambition to achieve extraordinary results, outperform the competition, and redefine industries. We complement our tailored, integrated expertise with a vibrant ecosystem of digital innovators to deliver better, faster, and more enduring outcomes. Since our founding in 1973, we have measured our success by the success of our clients, and we proudly maintain the highest level of client advocacy in the industry. 
 





 We are consistently recognized as one of the world’s best places to work, a champion of diversity and a model of social responsibility. We are currently ranked the \#1 consulting firm on Glassdoor’s Best Places to Work list, and we have maintained a spot in the top four on Glassdoor’s list for the last 13 years. We believe that diversity, inclusion, and collaboration is key to building extraordinary teams. 
 





 In 2004, Bain \& Company opened the Bain Capability Network office in Gurgaon, to provide the best\-in\-class internal support, efficiently and professionally, to both leadership and consulting teams in Bain offices across the region and globe. 
 





  
 





**Who You Will Work With** 






 Bain’s Sustainability Center of Excellence (CoE) plays a pivotal role in advancing the firm’s sustainability and carbon management initiatives. This position involves managing smaller sustainability cases, supporting complex cases under the direction of Project Leaders, and delivering actionable insights that drive Bain’s global sustainability goals.
 





 As part of the S\&R Flex Team, the Associate operates globally across diverse industries, managing 1–3 Analysts, and contributes to Bain’s offerings related to S\&R practice. The role emphasizes working with frameworks such as the GHG Protocol, analyzing Scope 1–3 emissions, and staying abreast of carbon regulations. The Associate also applies technical expertise by implementing small\-scale automation solutions using coding and AI tools.
 





  
 





**What You'll do** 




* Case Management and Problem Solving
	1. Lead discrete workstreams or smaller sustainability cases, ensuring high\-quality delivery and strong client impact
	2. Structure complex problems, define analytical approaches, and own analyses end\-to\-end under Project Leader guidance
	3. Review Analyst outputs, resolve challenges, and translate findings into clear recommendations
* Sustainability Expertise
	1. Build and apply expertise across topics including decarbonization, emissions benchmarking, regulations, and sustainability strategy
	2. Apply relevant frameworks such as Scope 1/2/3 emissions, target setting, transition pathways, CSRD, and CDP
	3. Stay current on emerging sustainability topics and translate developments into practical client insights
* Data Analysis and Technical Proficiency
	1. Use tools such as Excel, Alteryx, Tableau, Tableau Prep, and Power BI to analyze complex datasets and create impactful visualizations
	2. Build analytical models to support benchmarking, scenario assessment, and strategy development
	3. Apply automation, coding, and AI\-enabled approaches to improve analytical rigor and team efficiency
* Communication and Stakeholder Engagement
	1. Communicate findings and implications clearly to internal and external stakeholders, including senior Bain leadership
	2. Collaborate with Project Leaders, case teams, and experts to resolve issues across workstreams
	3. Manage and coach Analysts and contribute to S\&R CoE IP, tools, and capability development







  




**About You** 






**Education \& Experience** 




* Bachelor’s degree with 2–5 years of relevant experience, or Master’s degree with 0–3 years of relevant experience
* Prior exposure to sustainability, consulting, data analytics, engineering, economics, environmental studies, or a related field is strongly preferred
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills. Advanced Excel and PowerPoint skills, with experience using at least one analytics or visualization tool such as Alteryx, Tableau, Tableau Prep, or Power BI
* Working knowledge of sustainability topics such as emissions benchmarking, decarbonization, regulatory analysis, or disclosure frameworks
* Strong communication, collaboration, and team\-management skills, with the ability to operate effectively in a dynamic, fast\-paced environment
* Familiarity with coding, automation, and AI tools is preferred but not mandatory







  




**WHAT MAKES US A GREAT PLACE TO WORK:**
 We are proud to be consistently recognized as one of the world's best places to work, a champion of diversity and a model of social responsibility. We are currently ranked the \#1 consulting firm on Glassdoor’s Best Places to Work list, and we have maintained a spot in the top four on Glassdoor's list for the last 12 years. We believe that diversity, inclusion and collaboration is key to building extraordinary teams. We hire people with exceptional talents, abilities and potential, then create an environment where you can become the best version of yourself and thrive both professionally and personally. We are publicly recognized by external parties such as Fortune, Vault, Mogul, Working Mother, Glassdoor and the Human Rights Campaign for being a great place to work for diversity and inclusion, women, LGBTQ and parents.

title: Senior Manager - Project Approvals (Environment & Forests)
description:
**About Company**
 Founded in 2011, ReNew, is one of the largest renewable energy companies globally, with a leadership position in India. Listed on Nasdaq under the ticker RNW, ReNew develops, builds, owns, and operates utility\-scale wind energy projects, utility\-scale solar energy projects, utility\-scale firm power projects, and distributed solar energy projects. In addition to being a major independent power producer in India, ReNew is evolving to become an end\-to\-end decarbonization partner providing solutions in a just and inclusive manner in the areas of clean energy, green hydrogen, value\-added energy offerings through digitalisation, storage, and carbon markets that increasingly are integral to addressing climate change. With a total capacity of more than 13\.4 GW (including projects in pipeline), ReNew’s solar and wind energy projects are spread across 150\+ sites, with a presence spanning 18 states in India, contributing to 1\.9 % of India’s power capacity. Consequently, this has helped to avoid 0\.5% of India’s total carbon emissions and 1\.1% India’s total power sector emissions. In the over 10 years of its operation, ReNew has generated almost 1\.3 lakh jobs, directly and indirectly. ReNew has achieved market leadership in the Indian renewable energy industry against the backdrop of the Government of India’s policies to promote growth of this sector. ReNew’s current group of stockholders contains several marquee investors including CPP Investments, Abu Dhabi Investment Authority, Goldman Sachs, GEF SACEF and JERA. Its mission is to play a pivotal role in meeting India’s growing energy needs in an efficient, sustainable, and socially responsible manner. ReNew stands committed to providing clean, safe, affordable, and sustainable energy for all and has been at the forefront of leading climate action in India.

title: Technical Writer – AI Security Platform
description:
**Location:** 
 India, Remote\-First
   

  

**Employment:** 
 Full\-Time
   

  

**Start Date:** 
 February 2027
   

  

**Experience:** 
 4\+ years
   

  

**Language:** 
 Fluent English required
   

  

**Industry:** 
 Cybersecurity / Enterprise SaaS / AI Security
   

  

**About The Opportunity**
 Pragmatike is recruiting on behalf of a global enterprise cybersecurity company building a new generation of products to secure
 **AI agents, LLM\-powered applications, and the data they access** 
 .
   

  

 As the AI security platform moves toward general availability, customers, partners, and internal teams need documentation that is
 **accurate, technically rigorous, and easy to act on** 
 .
   

  

 You'll own the documentation ecosystem across product guides, API references, deployment and integration documentation, and release materials, working closely with
 **Go engineers, Product Managers, and Support** 
 .
   

  

 We're looking for a Technical Writer who is comfortable reading code and API specifications, can explain complex security and infrastructure concepts clearly, and uses AI tools to work more efficiently without compromising technical accuracy.
   

  

 What You'll Do
   

  

* Own end\-user, administrator, and API documentation for the AI security platform, from initial structure through ongoing maintenance.
* Create deployment and integration guides for gateway, endpoint, cloud discovery, and platform components, including code samples and configuration references.
* Write release notes and in\-product help, and maintain documentation standards and style guidelines.
* Work directly with engineers to generate and maintain API documentation from OpenAPI and protobuf definitions, keeping documentation aligned with product releases.
* Review technical examples and documentation for accuracy, consistency, and usability.
* Gather feedback from customers and Support to identify documentation gaps and improve clarity.
* Use AI tools to draft, review, update, and maintain documentation at scale while ensuring all technical content is properly validated.


 What We're Looking For
   

  

* 4\+ years of technical writing experience for developer\- or administrator\-facing B2B software.
* Ability to read Go, Python, OpenAPI, and protobuf well enough to accurately document APIs, configurations, and code examples.
* Experience with docs\-as\-code workflows, including Markdown, Git, static site generators, and CI\-based publishing.
* Strong understanding of cybersecurity, cloud infrastructure, or related technical concepts, or a demonstrated ability to learn complex technical domains quickly.
* Excellent written English with the ability to explain complex concepts clearly to both technical and non\-technical audiences.
* Practical experience using AI writing and coding assistants, combined with a rigorous process for reviewing and validating their output.
* Comfortable collaborating with distributed engineering and product teams across time zones.
* Strong ownership and attention to technical detail.


 Nice to Have
   

  

* Experience documenting cybersecurity, cloud, infrastructure, or AI/ML products.
* Experience with API documentation and publishing tools such as Redocly, Stoplight, Docusaurus, or equivalent.
* Basic Python or scripting skills for documentation automation.
* Experience working directly with engineering teams in a docs\-as\-code environment.


 AI\-First Team
   

  

 AI is a core part of how this team works.
   

  

 During the interview process, you'll be asked about how you use AI in your documentation workflow, including the tools you rely on, how you validate their output, and where AI has changed the way you work.
   

  

 We're looking for people who use AI as a
 **force multiplier for research, productivity, problem\-solving, and documentation quality** 
 , while maintaining a high bar for technical accuracy.
   

  

 Why Join
   

  

* Help shape the documentation for a new AI security platform as it moves toward general availability.
* Work directly with engineers, product teams, security researchers, and customers on emerging AI security challenges.
* Own a documentation ecosystem spanning APIs, integrations, deployment, administration, and product education.
* Work on technically complex products at the intersection of cybersecurity, cloud infrastructure, and agentic AI.
* Join a highly technical, distributed team where AI is a core part of daily work.


 Pragmatike is committed to a fair, transparent, and inclusive recruitment process. We do not discriminate based on age, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, marital or civil partner status, pregnancy or maternity, race, religion or belief, sex, or sexual orientation.
   

  

 In accordance with GDPR, your personal data will be processed lawfully, fairly, and securely and used solely for recruitment purposes, including sharing it with our client(s) for employment consideration.

title: Global Content Specialist
description:
**JOIN THE TEAM THAT’S POWERING PROGRESS** 
 Building cities. Driving commerce. Fueling Progress. For over 100 years, Allison has powered the vehicles and technology that move our world forward.
 



 What powers us? Our employees. From the first person hired by James Allison in 1915 to the thousands across the globe who work for Allison today, we're driving progress everywhere because we employ top talent worldwide. In both the Allison Transmission and Allison Off\-Highway Drive and Motion Systems business units, our team strives to Improve the Way the World Works.
 



 Learn more about this role and how you can begin
 *driving your career forward!* 




  





 Primary Purpose of Role:
 



  





 Develop, localize, and distribute high\-impact and memorable content for Group and Business Units across diverse segments and regions. Operating at the intersection of brand, content and marketing communications strategy, editorial excellence, and cross\-functional collaboration, the Global Content Specialist ensures that Allison's messaging and marketing collateral reflects the organization's commitment to engineering leadership and customer\-centric communication \- consistently and compellingly, across every touchpoint and geography. This role demands a sophisticated understanding of global audience dynamics, deep expertise in multi\-channel content production, and the editorial discipline to translate complex technical and commercial narratives into accessible, persuasive content that resonates with customers, partners, and external stakeholders worldwide.
 



  





 Key Responsibilities:
 



  





**Stakeholder Management** 
 \- Works closely with:
 



  




* Global Group: Global Lead, Brand \& Content, Media \& PR, Digital Communications, Internal Communications
* Business Unit and Regional Marketing teams, Segment Managers
* External Creative Agencies, PR agencies
* External customers including OEMs, Distributor Managed OEMs (DOEMs), distributor partners, to roll out annual online/digital communications plans.



  





**Content and Collateral Creation \&** 
**Management** 




  




* Creates, develops and updates (translated) content, copy \& marketing collateral (e.g. media information documents, messaging matrix/guides, presentations, brochures, advertisements, roll\-up designs, trade show visuals, Allison in Action stories, Talking Points etc.) in digital repositories
* (For copy) utilizing AI and other technologies to create efficiency; eventually (for DTP/design work) with support from external agencies.
* Comes up with new content \& collateral ideas.
* Adapt core content for local cultural, linguistic, and regulatory contexts; Develop and maintain localization frameworks and editorial guidelines that empower regional teams to produce on\-brand content autonomously, at scale.



  





**Web Content Development \& Publishing** 




  




* Architect, build, launch and maintain web pages (both internal \& external platforms) in alignment with global content strategy, campaign briefs, product launches, and strategic communications initiatives.
* Author and edit compelling, on\-brand web copy that adheres to Allison's editorial standards, tone of voice, and brand strategy.
* Manage end\-to\-end publishing process in Content Management System (CMS), ensuring accurate metadata, tagging, internal linking architecture.
* Coordinate with design, engineering, and regional marketing teams to deliver web experiences that are visually consistent and technically performant.



  





**Website Analytics \& Performance Optimization** 




  




* Define, track, and report on key content performance metrics — including SEO performance, website Call\-to\-Action, lead generation attribution to demonstrate content ROI and inform future strategy.
* Implements S(earch)EO and G(enerative)EO optimization activities eventually support by software tools or an external agency
* Apply SEO best practices and audience research insights throughout the content creation process to maximise organic visibility and relevance in priority markets.
* Conduct competitive content analysis and industry landscape reviews to identify gaps, emerging trends, and opportunities for differentiated positioning.
* Present performance insights and strategic recommendations to senior marketing leadership on a regular cadence.



  





**Ongoing Content Maintenance \& Brand Governance** 




  




* Execute regular content audits to identify outdated, duplicative, or underperforming pages, recommending and implementing timely updates.
* Maintain and refresh recurring content sections including News \& Press, Allison in Action, Campaign Hubs, and Tradeshow event pages.
* Ensure all published content meets global brand, legal, and compliance requirements, collaborating with stakeholders across functions to obtain necessary approvals.
* Uphold content governance policies, maintaining a structured editorial calendar that supports consistent, strategic publishing cadences.



  





**Planning \& Budget Tracking** 
 – Plans, budgets and tracks all expenses related to support activities provided by 3rd parties / external vendors; reports on Budget vs Actuals vs Outlook tracking.
 



  





**Key Performance Measures:** 




  




1. 95% up\-to\-date website pages for all key stakeholders; Monthly SEO and GEO improvements plan
2. 95% up\-to\-date marketing collateral, materials in Digital Asset Mngt System
3. 100% Group and Business unit marketing collateral (brochures, presentations etc.) on par with Brand Strategy Framework
4. Annual messaging guide assessment through internal \& external stakeholder survey to align and optimize brand strategy \& message house defined
5. Content publication velocity and adherence to editorial calendar commitments.
6. Page performance metrics: time on page, bounce rate, and conversion rates.
7. Accuracy \& timeliness of content governance activities, incl. audit completion rates.
8. Stakeholder satisfaction scores across internal content delivery processes.



  





 Competencies and Behaviors:
 



  





**The Highest Standards in Everything We Do** 



* Is widely trusted by others to deliver on what they commit to in a timely manner
* Reflects on mistakes and seeks to proactively address them
* Is transparent in their interactions and intentions
* Takes responsibility to deliver and can be counted on to deliver results in the right way
* Represents the company’s best interest at all times



**Drive a Positive Customer Experience** 



* Thinks through the consequence of actions with different stakeholders
* Establishes effective and positive relationships with customers, peers and leadership teams
* Gains the trust of others through active engagement



**Improve the Way the World Works** 



* Continually look to improve, evolve and advance our products, processes teams and self.
* Demonstrate agility, creativity, innovation and commitment to continuous improvement. Embraces evolving content formats, platforms, and technologies — including AI\-assisted tools — with agility and creative curiosity.
* Challenges status quo and finds creative solutions, has a bias for change, is eager to learn, is a self\-starter and suggests innovative solutions that bring value to the organization.



**Leveraging the Power of Teamwork** 



* Influence and lead others to better outcomes through inclusion and involvement.
* Bring people together and build bridges to connect people for common cause Allison and the community.
* Solves problems with peers in a professional and constructive way
* Is seen as a team player and cooperates with others within and outside own functional area and puts personal interests aside to achieve goals
* Encourages and demonstrates inclusion and collaboration with others finding common ground



  





**Qualifications:** 




  





 Bachelor’s or Master degree in (Digital) Communications, Marketing, English, Journalism, e\-Media/multimedia or a related field.
 



  





**Experience:** 




  




1. 5\-7 years of progressive experience in content marketing, editorial, or digital communications roles, with demonstrable exposure to global or multi\-regional content operations.
2. Proven track record of producing high\-quality, results\-driven content across multiple formats and channels within a complex, matrixed organisation — ideally within the technology, industrial, automotive, or advanced manufacturing sectors.
3. Exceptional written and verbal communication skills in English; proficiency in one or more additional languages is a significant advantage.
4. Demonstrated experience managing localisation and translation workflows at scale, including vendor management and quality assurance.
5. Experience with enterprise CMS systems, marketing automation platforms, and digital analytics tools (e.g., Salesforce Marketing Cloud, Adobe Experience Manager/Sitefinity, HubSpot, Google Analytics, SEMrush, or equivalents).
6. Strong command of SEO principles, keyword strategy, and content optimisation practices for global search markets.
7. Proficiency in data analysis and the ability to translate performance insights into actionable content recommendations.

title: Research Intern
company: Council on Energy, Environment and Water (CEEW)
description:
**Job Summary** 




 CEEW seeks to hire a suitable candidate for a full\-time intern position in the Sustainable Food Systems team to expand its capacity to conduct research and drive change. We are looking for a detail\-oriented researcher with a hunger for impact and the ambition to make our food system sustainable.
 



 The successful applicant will work across multiple teams within the Sustainable Food Systems programme, contributing to research on natural farming, SDGs, alternative development pathways, and development economics. The role will engage with areas including food systems transformation, agroecology, food security and nutrition, agricultural and rural economics, livelihoods, and related policy and governance issues, including through international platforms, research networks and global knowledge forums. The candidate should be prepared to contribute to related areas of research and take on additional responsibilities in response to emerging priorities and developments.
 



**Responsibilities and Duties**




 Support the team in undertaking qualitative and quantitative applied research on varied food system issues, including conducting background research and analysis, preparing concept notes, briefing notes, presentations, supporting stakeholder consultations, and presenting research findings in a clear and coherent manner. The candidate will also support strategic communication with the Fellow and Senior Programme Lead, as well as project management across multiple research projects, including tracking progress, coordinating with team members, and managing priorities.
 



  





**Selection Criteria and Key skills**



* Bachelor’s / Master's degree in Public Policy/Development Studies/Economics/Social Sciences/Food systems/Global policy/ International relations/ Agriculture or any other relevant field relevant for food system transformation.
* Analytical skills and knowledge of mixed methods – qualitative and quantitative research methods, relevant for impact evaluation
* Strong interest in and understanding of international relations (IR) and policy research
* Enthusiasm for cross\-team collaboration and working across diverse research areas and teams
* Strong communication skills for effective, efficient, and adaptive verbal and written communication and active listening
* Comfortable using AI tools to support research, analysis, and day\-to\-day work
* Ability to work effectively in a fast\-paced, dynamic environment and adapt to evolving priorities



**Personality**




  




* Willingness to learn new skills
* Ability to adapt to a new environment and deliver under tight deadlines in a professional environment
* Striving for rigour in research and quality in work output
* Ability to effectively work in a team while driving research with minimum assistance, when time demands independently.
* Ability to dig deeper into details, while also keeping a sense of the broader objectives and big picture
* Willingness to learn, grow and develop a personal and professional front, at a rapid pace with a steep learning curve
* Ability to work in an interdisciplinary and multicultural environment



 CEEW operates in a dynamic environment, and the candidate will be required to show flexibility in undertaking a variety of tasks.
 



**Compensation**




 Competitive compensation – commensurate to the experience and matching the best of standards adopted by industry or other similar organisations for similar roles.
 



**Application Process**




 CEEW is an equal opportunity employer, and the selection process does not discriminate on the basis of age, gender, ethnicity, religion, or caste. Female candidates are encouraged to apply.
 



***Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis. Interested applicants are advised to apply at the earliest possible.***




*Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted. We appreciate your interest.*

**Experience**

 People with the ability to work in a collaborative manner to provide services across multiple client departments while following the commercial and legal requirements. We look for people who are agile, curious, mindful, and able to sustain positive energy, while being adaptable and creative in their approach.

 Fuelled by the brilliance of our people, EY has emerged as the strongest brand and the most attractive employer in our field, with market\-leading growth over competitors. title: Assistant Project Coordinator- (Research)/Senior Researcher - Delhi
description:
Assistant Project Coordinator \- (Research) / Senior Researcher
 



 Indian Police Foundation \| Internal Police Reforms Project
 



  





 Organisation: Indian Police Foundation
 



 Project: Internal Police Reforms Project
 



 Location: Indian Police Foundation HQ, New Delhi (C\-8, 8758, Vasant Kunj, New Delhi \- 110070\)
 



 Number of Positions: 1
 



 Tenure: Contractual. Offered initially for 1 year but extendable till the completion of the project (2027\-2028\).
 



 Remuneration: Rs. 75,000 per month (Assistant Project Coordinator \- Research) / Rs. 60,000 per month (Senior Researcher), including Rs. 5,000 as transport allowance.
 



 Last date to apply: 5 October 2026, till 4:00 PM only.
 



  





 OVERVIEW
 



  





 Applications are invited for the position of Assistant Project Coordinator \- (Research)/Senior Researcher on a contractual basis.
 



  





 Candidates possessing a minimum of 3 years or more of relevant experience will be considered for the position of Assistant Project Coordinator (Research). However, candidates shortlisted with less than 3 years of relevant experience will be considered for the position of Senior Researcher.
 



  





 Although the position is in Delhi, the APC\- Research/Senior Researcher is expected to travel to various (3 states) both for research as well as project implementation and monitoring.
 



  





 ABOUT THE ROLE
 



  





 The role of the Assistant Project Coordinator \- (Research)/Senior Researcher involves coordinating both the research and operational components of the Internal Police Reforms Project. Working closely with the Project Director (PD), Project Coordinator (PC), and State Supervisors, the he/she will play a key role in project planning, research, implementation, coordination, monitoring, and documentation across three states (Punjab, Telangana \& Tamil Nadu).
 



  





 ESSENTIAL QUALIFICATIONS
 



  





 \- Educational Qualification: M.A in Social Sciences/Police Sciences/Criminology/Public Safety or any other related field. However, candidates with Ph.D. in relevant domains will be preferred.
 



 \- Researcher/Consultant with experience of 3 years or more in social research in universities, other research institutes, NGOs, think tanks, or consulting firms. (Minimum experience may be relaxed in exceptional cases at the discretion of the Project Director).
 



 \- Experience in Independent Research Study Design and leading/mentoring research team.
 



 \- Proficiency \& experience in developing and conducting Baseline, Midline and Endline evaluation study.
 



 \- Proficiency in Research Tool Development for empirical data collection.
 



 \- Proficiency in mixed\-data \- quantitative and qualitative \- analysis \& and knowledge of quantitative data analysis software (advance excel, SPSS/STATA).
 



 \- Ability to understand and communicate the meaning of field\-based data and writing research report.
 



 \- Strong management, coordination and leadership skills for engagement with senior police officers, trainers, research staff and other research institutions.
 



 \- High level of proficiency in computer skills.
 



 \- Willingness and good health to undertake field visits (as and when required).
 



 \- Good command over English and Hindi.
 



 \- Attend the IPF office at Vasant Kunj, Delhi, on a regular basis.
 



  





 DESIRABLE
 



  





 \- Previous experience of working with Police organisations.
 



 \- Familiarity with criminal laws (major \& minor).
 



 \- Familiarity with relevant Supreme Court judgments \& NHRC directives.
 



 \- Familiarity with MHA and State Government circulars related to citizen centric policing.
 



 \- Familiarity with recommendations of various police commissions, including the National Police Commission (1979\-81\), related to citizen centric policing.
 



 \- Publications of Research papers/articles in various journals/magazines/Newspapers.
 



  





 ROLES AND RESPONSIBILITIES
 



  





 1\. Research and Data Analysis
 



  





 \- Head the research team, provide guidance to Research Associates both in Headquarters \& States, and monitor their work.
 



 \- Guide Research Associates in data analysis for various stakeholders for both quantitative and qualitative data collected through three tools (structured questionnaires, FGDs, and in\-depth interviews).
 



 \- Coordinate with and visit the external agencies engaged for data analysis \& report writing (Centre for Economic \& Social Studies, Hyderabad \& Centre for Good Governance, Hyderabad).
 



 \- Guide and Supervise Research Associates in desk research, including analysis of reports of the National Police Commission and other committees on police reforms.
 



 \- Formulation of Reports to State DGP on Public Grievances in 3 states based on data analysis.
 



  





 2\. Formulation of Change Manual
 



  





 \- Assist in the Formulation of Change Manual \& its action plan for all the 3 states based on the Project Focus areas, namely improving Compliant / FIR Registration and Police Response, improving Citizen Services and Community Engagement, prevention of Harassment by Police, and improving Police Conduct and Behaviour.
 



 \- Presentation of Change Manual to the respective state DGPs in 3 States.
 



  





 3\. Baseline and Endline Evaluation
 



  





 \- Work on evaluation parameters, selection of police stations for evaluation, training of field enumerators, and ensure that the data required by the agency for conducting baseline and endline evaluations is provided in a timely manner.
 



 \- Guide in the formulation of Data Collection Tools by evaluation agencies.
 



 \- Support and monitor the execution of Baseline and Endline evaluations by independent agency in selected police stations across Punjab, Telangana, and Tamil Nadu.
 



 \- Review and scrutinize the reports prepared by the evaluation agencies.
 



  





 4\. Engagement with Experts
 



  





 Assist the Project Director and Project Coordinator in engaging with Experts for vetting and finalization of the following activities:
 



  





 \- Finalization of Research Methodology
 



 \- Evaluation Parameters for (Baseline and Endline Evaluation)
 



 \- Change Manual prepared for all 3 states
 



 \- Baseline \& Endline Reports prepared by Evaluation agencies
 



 \- Final Project report (combined report for all 3 States)
 



  





 5\. Training
 



  





 \- Assist in the preparation of state\-specific training manual \& training materials.
 



 \- Support and participate in the conduct of training programmes for police office in all 3 states.
 



  





 6\. Project Implementation and Monitoring
 



  





 \- Support monitoring of project implementation across 90 police stations in three states, including field visits to selected police stations on quarterly basis.
 



  





 7\. Coordination
 



  





 Ensuring smooth communication, information exchange and prompt follow up with:
 



  





 \- All state project monitoring units (State Supervisor \& Research Associates in 3 states)
 



 \- External agencies engaged in data analysis (CESS, Hyderabad \& CGG, Hyderabad)
 



 \- Evaluation Agencies for Baseline \& Endline Evaluation in 3 states
 



 \- Donor Agency
 



  





 8\. Documentation and Reporting
 



  





 \- Documentation of Best Practice Visit reports submitted by the Project Coordinator, State Supervisors \& Assistant Project Coordinator \- (Research)/Senior Researcher (himself).
 



 \- Formulation of Reports to the Donor Agency as and when required.
 



 \- Preparation of the Final Project Report, based on Public consultation meetings, Change Manual, baseline and endline evaluation reports from the respective states and monthly reports from respective State Supervisors.
 



  





 9\. Miscellaneous
 



  





 \- Assistant Project Coordinator \- (Research)/Senior Researcher will report to the Project Director and Project Coordinator.
 



 \- In\-addition to the above\-mentioned job chart, the Project Director \& Project Coordinator may assign any other project related tasks from time to time.
 



  





 SALARY AND OTHER SERVICE CONDITIONS
 



  





 \- Assistant Project Coordinator \- (Research): Rs. 75,000 per month (including Rs. 5,000 as transport allowance)
 



 \- Senior Researcher: Rs. 60,000 per month (including Rs. 5,000 as transport allowance)
 



 \- The selected candidate will have to give the undertaking in the form of the bond to serve for minimum period of one year.
 



 \- Economy\-class airfare for visits to various States and UTs
 



 \- Accommodation in police guest houses (or will be reimbursed as per IPF policy).
 



 \- Other service conditions will be governed by IPF HR and other policies
 



  





 SELECTION PROCESS
 



  





 Selection will be based on a written examination and an interview (if you clear the written exam) to be held on 15th \& 16th October 2026 at IPF HQ New Delhi.
 



  





 HOW TO APPLY
 



  





 Please visit https://www.policefoundationindia.org/careers for detailed guidelines.
 



  





 \- Download the application form and fill it out electronically, along with updated CV in PDF format \& send them to us at recruitment.tpfi@gmail.com
 



 \- For queries, write to recruitment.tpfi@gmail.com or contact 9625878853 (Admin Officer) \& 9910224876 (Project Coordinator).
 



 \- Last date for online submission of applications: 5th October 2026 till 4:00 PM only.

title: Solution Engineer, Manager
description:
**Overview**
 WELCOME TO SITA
   

  

 At SITA, we keep airports moving, airlines flying smoothly, and borders open. Our technology and communication innovations power the success of the global air travel industry.
   

  

 You'll find us in 95% of international airports, working closely with over 2,500 transportation and government clients. Each partnership brings unique challenges, and we thrive on delivering fresh solutions and cutting\-edge tech to keep operations running like clockwork. We don't just move the world forward\-we're proud to be recognized as a
 **Great Place to Work** 
 ® by 79% of our employees and certified in most of our growing locations. Here, we feel empowered, supported, and inspired to grow.
   

  

 Are you ready to love your job?
   

  

 The adventure begins right here, with you, at SITA.
   

  

 PURPOSE
   

  

 You will become a member of the border management’s architecture team and provide consulting services to the product and customer delivery teams, helping with guidance throughout the design and development process of our business opportunities. You will also be designing and developing solution architectures to meet business requirements and provide value for money. The ability to be hands\-on and support product and project delivery and transition work is important in addition to an architecture and design role.
   

  

 As Solution Engineer Manager you will have the opportunity to be involved in the end\-to\-end solution process at both the sales and delivery stages of the customer relationship, translating customer aims and requirements into a new solution with agreement through our governance processes.
   

  

 Reporting to the Solution Engineer Director at SITA At Borders, you will be part of a team challenging the status quo, designing solutions that employ strong architecture frameworks and using technologies such as AI/Machine Learning, Biometrics Matching and Identity Management.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
 As a Manager, Customer Solution Engineering, you will work closely with other members of the Engineering team, supporting, and contributing to all aspects of the role, including:
   

  

* Design/coordinate development of standard and complex solutions which may involve multiple parties both internally and externally including the selection of 3rd party vendors to meet customer requirements. Solutions may support government, border management, immigration, customs, or national security customers operating in mission\-critical environments.
* Support account teams or competency centers during the pre\-contract phases (qualification proposals and contract) with technical designs and advice. Including support for high\-value, long\-cycle government procurement processes such as RFIs, RFPs, and competitive dialogue.
* Provide the technical qualification and own the technical parts of proposals submitted to customers through knowledge of current new or evolving technologies and SITA solution portfolios. Including ownership of technical risk, compliance, and feasibility for large\-scale government and border programs.
* Promote SITA by furnishing customers with comprehensive up\-to\-date information on current products, product enhancements and new solutions through customer meetings and workshops. Leading technical workshops with senior government and operational stakeholders.
* Facilitate designs to be efficiently implemented Right the First Time (RFT) and supported operationally. Ensuring solutions are designed for operability, maintainability, and 24/7 support.
* Collaborate with colleague to gain and share ideas and opportunities. Collaborating across sales, delivery, security, and operations teams.
* Account for designing solutions for large or complex programs in accordance with business strategies, standards, and processes. Designing national\-scale systems with high availability, resilience, and performance requirements.
* Ensure designs in compliance with Industry standards and architectural plans. Ensuring compliance with international, aviation, and border standards such as ICAO, IATA and ISO.
* Lead and coordinate with subject matter experts (SMEs) involved with solution design and subsequent implementation. Acting as solution authority coordinating products, security, infrastructure, and integration SMEs.
* Work with the architects, development, and products engineering teams within the SITA Government business unit to products successful customer designs. Ensuring alignment with product roadmaps, architectural principles, and security frameworks.
* Assess the viability and value of new technologies and patterns, working to ensure we align with the business’s technical aims for scalability and growth. Evaluating emerging technologies in biometrics, identity management, secure integration, and data platforms.
* Understanding of system security. Designing secure\-by\-design solutions including IAM, encryption, network security, and compliance with government security and assurance frameworks.


**Qualifications**
 ABOUT YOUR SKILLS
   

  

* 6–8 years of experience in Information Technology, Telecom Industry or Air Transport Industry technology in a technical pre\-sales role or lead architect role. Experience working with government or public\-sector customers is highly desirable.
* BS level Technical Degree or equivalent experience in Engineering Computer Technologies.
* Ability to provide technical system solutions, determine overall design direction and provide hardware recommendations for complex technical issues. Including solutions operating in mission\-critical and high\-availability environments.
* Experienced in designing, integrating, and managing software solutions. Including large\-scale, multi\-system integrations and legacy interoperability.
* Have a background in working in a systems integration industry. Including delivery of systems\-of\-systems in complex stakeholder environments.
* Proven track record in producing, communicating and documenting successful technical customer solutions. Including high\-level and detailed design documentation (HLD/LLD) for regulated environments.
* Pre\-Sales Business and or Commercial experience is a plus. Including support to government tenders and commercial negotiations.
* Have a very strong solutions \& application architecture background, with a very good understanding how it impacts the other IT disciplines.
* A willingness to keep up to date with developments in new technology.
* An understanding of information legislation, such as the Data Protection Act and GDPR. Including handling of biometric and highly sensitive personal data.
* Ability to demonstrate an understanding of the end\-to\-end solution.
* Deliver and ensure quality assurance against the design during the project phases. Including participation in design governance, reviews, and acceptance milestones.
* Strong written and oral communication skills, and the ability to effectively communicate with technical and non\-technical audiences. Including engagement with senior government and executive stakeholders.
* Problem\-solving and good analytical skills.
* Good organizational skills.
* Flexibility and adaptability.
* Team Player and self starter.


 NICE\-TO\-HAVE
   

  

* Experience in Aviation and borders industry. Including border management, immigration, customs, or law enforcement solutions.
* TOGAF certificate
* ITIL
* Experience with biometric technologies, cloud or hybrid architectures, international border standards, or security certifications.


**What We Offer**
 We're all about diversity. We operate in 200 countries and speak 60 different languages and cultures. We're really proud of our inclusive environment. Our offices are comfortable and fun places to work, and we make sure you get to work from home too. Find out what it's like to join our team and take a step closer to your best life ever.
   

  

 🏡
 **Flex Week:** 
 Work from home up to 2 days/week (depending on your team's needs)
   

  

 ⏰
 **Flex Day:** 
 Make your workday suit your life and plans.
   

  

 🌎
 **Flex\-Location:** 
 Take up to 30 days a year to work from any location in the world.
   

  

 🌿
 **Employee Wellbeing:** 
 We have got you covered with our Employee Assistance Program (EAP), for you and your dependents 24/7, 365 days/year. We also offer Champion Health \- a personalized platform that supports a range of wellbeing needs.
   

  

 🚀
 **Professional Development:** 
 Level up your skills with our training platforms, including LinkedIn Learning!
   

  

 🙌
 **Competitive Benefits:** 
 Competitive benefits that make sense with both your local market and employment status.
   

  

*SITA is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We value a diverse workforce. In support of our Employment Equity Program, we encourage women, aboriginal people, members of visible minorities, and/or persons with disabilities to apply and self\-identify in the application process.*

title: Manager
description:
**Job Description:**
**About Us**
 At Bank of America, we are guided by a common purpose to help make financial lives better through the power of every connection. Responsible Growth is how we run our company and how we deliver for our clients, teammates, communities and shareholders every day.
   

  

 One of the keys to driving Responsible Growth is being a great place to work for our teammates around the world. We’re devoted to being a diverse and inclusive workplace for everyone. We hire individuals with a broad range of backgrounds and experiences and invest heavily in our teammates and their families by offering competitive benefits to support their physical, emotional, and financial well\-being.
   

  

 Bank of America believes both in the importance of working together and offering flexibility to our employees. We use a multi\-faceted approach for flexibility, depending on the various roles in our organization.
   

  

 Working at Bank of America will give you a great career with opportunities to learn, grow and make an impact, along with the power to make a difference. Join us!
   

  

**Global Business Services**
 Global Business Services delivers Technology and Operations capabilities to Lines of Business and Staff Support Functions of Bank of America through a centrally managed, globally integrated delivery model and globally resilient operations.
   

  

 Global Business Services is recognized for flawless execution, sound risk management, operational resiliency, operational excellence and innovation.
   

  

 In India, we are present in five locations and operate as BA Continuum India Private Limited (BACI), a non\-banking subsidiary of Bank of America Corporation and the operating company for India operations of Global Business Services.
   

  

**Process Overview\***
 Global Finance was set up in 2007 as a part of the CFO Global Delivery strategy to provide offshore delivery to Line of Business and Enterprise Finance functions. The capabilities hosted include Accounts Payable, General Accounting \& Reconciliations, Management Reporting \& Analysis, Research \& Analytics, Financial Transaction Processing, Finance Systems Support \& Regulatory reporting. Over the years, the scope of Global Finance has been expanded to include operations for other enterprise control functions like Human Resources and Risk and Compliance.
   

  

 The CFOC (CFO Change) team, which is part of the COO \& Governance organization within CFO division, delivers finance projects and technology solutions for the Bank of America (BAC) enterprise and also supports Line of Business (LOB) projects that impact our core finance and general ledger applications. The CFO Change team is responsible for overall program/project management, business analysis and requirements, functional design, testing, organization readiness and deployment activities.
   

  

**Job Description\***
 This role is for a Business Analyst resource responsible for documenting detailed business requirements in support of the FCPS delivery of programs/projects in the US, EMEA, APAC and LATAM regulatory reporting groups and general ledger operations. The resource will be responsible for (1\) understanding the Change, (2\) defining and documenting the current state (if applicable) and target state processes and (3\) ensuring collaboration with Technology teams \& Users until implementation of the Change. It requires working closely with the Business Lead/Product Owner, including upstream / downstream Stakeholders and Technology to ensure all aspects of the change are being considered and prioritized when documenting the requirements. The business requirements are the foundation for the design, build, test, operational / organizational readiness, and deployment activities in the life cycle of a project.
   

  

**Responsibilities\***
* Understanding the Regulatory Change and documenting detailed requirements. This includes functional capabilities, workflow needs, business rules, reporting requirements and timelines, etc. Collaborate with the Users \& procure all required sign offs.
* Identifying current state processes and the target state scope, objective and business outcomes of the Program/Project
* Identifying any data sourcing requirements, documenting them and coordinating with relevant Teams
* Understanding the in\-house GRIFFIN \& AXIOM design and documenting functional specifications in conjunction to the business requirements
* Creating high quality JIRAs documenting all critical aspects including business requirements, mapping requirements, acceptance criteria, etc using the BAC enterprise change management templates
* Create process maps or operating model where necessary.
* Walkthrough of the requirements to Technology and participating in the sprint planning along with the Project Manager.
* Collaborating with the test teams to clearly set the expectations from a Quality or User Acceptance Testing perspective.
* Regression before every code release into production.
* Facilitate review sessions with Business, Technology \& Testing Teams where relevant.


**Requirements\***
**Education\***
 Graduate degree in Commerce, Business or Technology.
   

  

 Certifications If Any \- AXIOM / Business Analysis etc.
   

  

**Experience Range\***
 7 to 10 years
   

  

**Foundational skills\***
* Experience as a Functional Business Analyst in technology implementation projects, having written Business requirement documents (BRDs)
* Extremely strong Knowledge of EMEA regulatory reports (COREP, Finrep, AnaCredit, ESG etc..) and Strong knowledge of financial concepts
* Ability to understand complex business processes and breakdown to process components.
* Demonstrate ability to work in a fast\-paced, every\-changing, highly collaborative environment.
* Strong knowledge of creating process maps
* Strong relationship management and interpersonal skills, ability to build strong rapport, respect and trust with key stakeholders and constituents.
* Professional written and verbal communication skills
* Excellent analytical skills and ability to identify/raise questions, and problem\-solving capabilities.
* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail, and good with numbers
* Proficient with Microsoft Office products (particularly MS Excel, Word, Visio, PowerPoint)


**Desired Skills**
* Exposure to projects in Financial Accounting and reporting (in Financial Control / Product Control/Treasury), and/or in Risk Regulatory reporting (Market or Counterparty risk) in financial services industry
* Expertise in Axiom Regulatory platform (if possible, AXIOM certified)
* Knowledge of Banking and Capital market products
* Understanding of automation tools like Alteryx, Tableau, Power BI
* Knowledge/ Experience with Copilot/ Other AI tools usage in day\-to\-day BAU processes
* SQL, Database knowledge \& ability to analyze data and related flows
* Knowledge of Agile methodology and tools (i.e., JIRA)


**Work Timings\***
 11:30 am to 8:30 pm
   

  

**Job Location\***
 Gurugram/Mumbai

 He/she will perform the following functions:

**Project Management**

* Collaborate with other practice areas and regional units to operationalize strategic plans, offering both logistical and technical inputs.
* Demonstrate accountability in decision\-making, efficient resource management, and adherence to organizational values.

* Align work practices with Tarutium’s culture and leadership expectations.

**Knowledge Works**
* Lead and support in knowledge creation and dissemination through articles, case studies, blogs, and technical papers in reputable platforms.
* Organize and actively participate in conferences, workshops, and seminars to connect with and contribute to academic and professional communities.


**Job Specification: Qualification \& Experience**
* Postgraduate or Professional degree in Public Health/BDS/Health Management or any other discipline relevant to this role from reputed institutes
* At least minimum 1\-3 years’ experience in the climate, health, and nutrition sector especially with national and international organizations.

title: MEP Tendering
description:
**Company Description** 
 Amber Electrotech Ltd, founded in 1958 as an electrical contracting agency, has grown into a comprehensive turnkey solution provider for a wide range of electrical projects. The company delivers internal and external electrification and substation services, including high\-end and conventional solutions, and has expanded to a business of approximately $20 million. With a passionate team of engineers, Amber Electrotech focuses on providing best\-in\-class electrical services at competitive prices while consistently exceeding customer expectations. As a diversified turnkey provider, the company offers electrical techno\-commercial solutions and is equipped to manage stringent S.I.T.C requirements and related clearances from relevant electrical authorities.
   

**Role Description** 
 This is a full\-time, on\-site MEP Tendering role based in Okhla. The role involves preparing and reviewing tender documents, BOQs, and cost estimates for MEP (Mechanical, Electrical, and Plumbing) projects, ensuring accuracy, compliance, and alignment with client specifications. The MEP Tendering professional will coordinate with engineering, procurement, and project teams to gather technical inputs, clarify scope, and optimize pricing and solutions. Day\-to\-day responsibilities include analyzing drawings and specifications, obtaining vendor quotations, preparing techno\-commercial offers, and supporting negotiations and bid submissions. The role also includes maintaining tender documentation, tracking deadlines, and contributing to continuous improvement of tendering processes and templates.
   

**Qualifications**
  

* Strong knowledge of MEP systems, including electrical distribution, HVAC, plumbing, and related building services.
* Experience in tendering, estimation, and BOQ preparation for MEP or electrical turnkey projects.
* Ability to read and interpret technical drawings, specifications, and standards.
* Proficiency with MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint) and familiarity with estimation or project management software.
* Bachelor’s degree or diploma in Electrical, Mechanical, or related Engineering discipline.
* Excellent analytical, numerical, and problem\-solving skills, with attention to detail and accuracy.
* Effective communication and collaboration skills for working with cross\-functional teams, vendors, and clients.
* Prior experience in contracting or turnkey solution companies, especially in S.I.T.C projects, is an advantage.
* Ability to work on\-site in Okhla and manage multiple tenders and deadlines simultaneously.
