title: Computer Engineering
description:
**Computer Engineering — AI Data Trainer**
**About The Role**
 We're looking for computer engineering experts to help train and improve the next generation of AI models. At Alignerr, we partner with the world's leading AI research labs — and your deep technical knowledge is exactly what's needed to make these systems smarter, more accurate, and more reliable.
   

  

 You'll stress\-test advanced language models on complex hardware and systems topics, expose their failure modes, and help build the ground\-truth solutions that shape how AI reasons about computer engineering.
   

  

* Organization: Alignerr
* Type: Hourly Contract
* Location: Remote
* Commitment: 10–40 hours/week


**What You'll Do**
* Design Challenging Problems — Create advanced computer engineering scenarios spanning RISC\-V/ARM architecture, FPGA development, memory management, hardware\-software co\-design, embedded systems, and more
* Author Gold\-Standard Solutions — Write rigorous, step\-by\-step technical solutions including assembly code, HDL snippets, and architectural diagrams that serve as benchmarks for AI training
* Audit AI Outputs — Evaluate AI\-generated code (C/C\+\+, Verilog, VHDL), logic gate designs, and OS kernel implementations for technical accuracy, efficiency, and standards compliance
* Improve AI Reasoning — Identify flaws in AI\-generated reasoning — such as race conditions, memory leaks, or timing constraint violations — and provide structured feedback to improve model performance


**Who You Are**
* Pursuing or holding a Master's or PhD in Computer Engineering, Computer Science (hardware focus), or a closely related field
* Strong foundational knowledge in one or more of: Computer Architecture, Embedded Systems, Digital Logic Design, or Operating Systems
* Able to communicate complex hardware concepts and low\-level software logic clearly in writing
* Highly detail\-oriented — comfortable working at the level of bit operations, clock cycles, and technical documentation
* No prior AI experience required


**Nice to Have**
* Experience with data annotation, data quality, or AI evaluation workflows
* Proficiency in engineering tools such as MATLAB, ANSYS, or similar platforms
* Familiarity with IoT, networking, distributed systems, or hardware security domains


**Why Join Us**
* Work on cutting\-edge AI projects alongside top research labs and institutions
* Fully remote and flexible — work on your own schedule, from anywhere
* Freelance perks: autonomy, variety, and collaboration with experts worldwide
* Gain rare, firsthand exposure to how advanced LLMs are built and trained
* Potential for ongoing work and contract extension

title: Business Performance Analyst
description:
**Business Performance Analyst (AI Training)**
**About The Role**
 What if your business expertise and leadership skills could directly shape how AI understands commerce, finance, strategy, and operations? We're looking for experienced Business Performance Analysts to lead and mentor a team of analysts creating high\-quality, business\-focused content that trains the next generation of AI models.
   

  

 This is a fully remote, flexible contract role ideal for someone who thrives at the intersection of people management, analytical rigour, and subject matter expertise. No prior AI experience required — your business background is what matters.
   

  

* Organization: Alignerr
* Type: Hourly Contract
* Location: Remote
* Commitment: 10–40 hours/week


**What You'll Do**
* Lead and mentor a team of Business Analysts and Content Specialists producing business\-domain content for AI training
* Allocate tasks, manage workflows, and ensure timely delivery of high\-quality outputs
* Conduct quality assurance reviews and continuously refine team processes for greater efficiency
* Provide constructive performance feedback, hands\-on coaching, and ongoing team development
* Serve as the primary point of contact for project stakeholders, delivering regular progress updates
* Guide the creation of case studies, business scenarios, and structured analytical content across domains including finance, policy, e\-commerce, and operations


**Who You Are**
* Experienced team leader with a strong track record of managing and developing analysts or specialists
* Deep practitioner in business analysis, consulting, or a related domain — you know your subject inside out
* Sharp analytical thinker who can evaluate the quality, logic, and accuracy of business content
* Clear, confident communicator who can translate complex ideas into structured, actionable feedback
* Self\-directed and organised — you manage priorities well and deliver without hand\-holding
* Creative and lateral thinker who can approach business problems from multiple angles
* No prior AI or tech experience required


**Requirements**
* Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, Accounting, Economics, Statistics, or a related field — or equivalent professional experience
* 2\+ years of direct team management experience
* 3–6 years of experience in business analysis, management consulting, content strategy, or domain\-focused project work
* Strong research, analytical, and critical evaluation skills
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills


**Nice to Have**
* Master's degree or MBA in a relevant business or quantitative discipline
* Experience with data annotation, content evaluation, or quality assurance systems
* Background in case study writing, academic content, or structured business research
* Familiarity with AI tools or large language model workflows as an end user


**Why Join Us**
* Work on cutting\-edge AI projects alongside leading research labs
* Fully remote and flexible — work when and where it suits you
* Freelance autonomy with the structure of meaningful, leadership\-level work
* Gain rare, hands\-on exposure to how advanced AI models are trained and evaluated
* Contribute to work that shapes how AI reasons about business, finance, and strategy at scale
* Potential for ongoing work and contract extension as new projects launch

title: Technical Writer
description:
Yotta Data Services is India’s leading sovereign AI infrastructure, cloud platform and data center services company, enabling enterprises, governments, startups, and digital platforms to build, deploy, and scale next\-Generation AI and digital workloads securely within India. With hyperscale data center campuses in Navi Mumbai and Greater Noida (Delhi NCR), advanced GPU\-powered AI infrastructure, and a comprehensive ecosystem of cloud, AI, hosting, cybersecurity, and managed platform services, Yotta delivers high\-performance, scalable, and compliant digital infrastructure built for the AI era. Yotta is at the forefront of powering India’s sovereign AI and digital transformation journey through world\-class infrastructure, deep technology partnerships, and fully India\-hosted enterprise\-grade platforms.
 



  





**Role** 




 This role bridges technical innovation and operational governance. You will design automation frameworks to optimize workflows while directly managing Service Level Agreements (SLAs) and client expectations. By automating manual processes and governing system KPIs, you will drive operational excellence without handling day\-to\-day incident management. Min 2\-year experience.
 



  





**Responsibilities** 



* Automation Engineering: Design, build, and maintain automation scripts and BI reports to eliminate operational bottlenecks.
* SLA Governance: Develop, negotiate, and monitor SLAs and Operational Level Agreements (OLAs) to ensure strict compliance.
* Process Optimization: Identify manual work patterns and engineer automated workflows to improve service delivery speeds.
* Performance Reporting: Analyze system data to build KPI dashboards, providing performance visibility to stakeholders.
* Cross\-Team Collaboration: Partner with the internal Incident Management team to implement long\-term automated fixes for recurring technical issues.



  





**Responsibilities** 



* CONSTITUENTS
* File Management
* Client’s engagements for SLAs monitoring
* Technical documentation
* INDICATORS OF SUCCESS
* Documents management
* Timeliness and accuracy of SLA’s reporting and compilation



  





**Qualifications** 



* Bachelor’s degree in computer science or related field preferred.



  





**Required Skills** 



* Advanced experience with Microsoft Office Suite
* Experience with Excel \& Power BI preferred
* Able to collaborate effectively with other company employees and managers to ensure teamwork
* Exposure to Power BI, data visualization and dashboard creation
* Basic understanding of SLA/OLA management and service delivery processes
* Experience in process automation and workflow optimization

title: Technical Writer
description:

**Office location**

 : https://www.sumtracker.com

 Sumtracker is a fast\-growing SaaS startup revolutionising inventory management for e\-commerce businesses worldwide. Founded by IIT Delhi alumni Ankit and Kush in 2022, we support a global client base across the US, UK and Australia.
 



  





 We're building the future of inventory management \- from real\-time stock sync across channels to AI\-powered forecasting and intelligent automation.
 



  





 Join us as we make a real difference for online sellers!

 We're looking for a Technical Writer who can own our help documentation and product content end\-to\-end. You'll work closely with the product and support teams to make sure our customers can find clear, accurate answers without needing to reach out to support.
 



  





 This role leans heavily toward help docs and product content, with some scope for blog writing and SEO content over time.

 This is a high\-ownership individual contributor role.
 



  




* Write and maintain help centre articles, setup guides, and how\-to tutorials

 : Take on a pivotal role with full ownership, accelerating your career

* **Cutting\-edge work** 
 : Solve real problems using AI and modern tools



  





**Work Policy** 




 We are an in\-office company with a 5\-day work week
 



  





**Team and Culture** 




 At Sumtracker, we foster a culture that values autonomy, ownership, and transparency

 Well\-defined processes that empower you to work independently

title: Senior Technical Writer

We value diverse perspectives and celebrate differences, working together with colleagues and clients to build strong connections.

Our team values professionals who thoughtfully integrate AI into their daily work, delivering exceptional results while relying on the human judgment and creativity that drive real innovation.

title: Senior Manager
description:
**Job Description:**
**About Us**
 At Bank of America, we are guided by a common purpose to help make financial lives better through the power of every connection. We do this by driving Responsible Growth and delivering for our clients, teammates, communities and shareholders every day.
   

  

 Being a Great Place to Work and providing a culture of caring is core to how we drive Responsible Growth. We are intentional about fostering an inclusive workplace where every teammate has the opportunity to succeed, build a career and contribute to our shared success. This includes attracting and developing exceptional talent, recognizing and rewarding performance, and supporting our teammates’ physical, emotional, and financial wellness through affordable, competitive and flexible benefits.
   

  

 We value the unique perspectives individuals bring from all backgrounds and career paths \- whether shaped by military service, community college education, or a wide range of work and life experiences. These journeys foster resilience, leadership and innovation, strengthening our workforce and positively impact the communities we serve.
   

  

 Bank of America is committed to an in\-office culture that supports collaboration, engagement, and career development. Our approach includes clear in\-office expectations, while providing an appropriate level of flexibility based on role\-specific responsibilities and business needs.
   

  

 At Bank of America, you can build a successful career with opportunities to learn, grow, and make an impact. Join us!
   

  

**Global Business Services**
 Global Business Services delivers Technology and Operations capabilities to Lines of Business and Staff Support Functions of Bank of America through a centrally managed, globally integrated delivery model and globally resilient operations.
   

  

 Global Business Services is recognized for flawless execution, sound risk management, operational resiliency, operational excellence and innovation.
   

  

 In India, we are present in five locations and operate as BA Continuum India Private Limited (BACI), a non\-banking subsidiary of Bank of America Corporation and the operating company for India operations of Global Business Services.
   

  

**Process Overview\***
 Global Finance was set up in 2007 as a part of the CFO Global Delivery strategy to provide offshore delivery to Line of Business and Enterprise Finance functions. The capabilities hosted include Accounts Payable, General Accounting \& Reconciliations, Management Reporting \& Analysis, Research \& Analytics, Financial Transaction Processing, Finance Systems Support \& Regulatory reporting. Over the years, the scope of Global Finance has been expanded to include operations for other enterprise control functions like Human Resources and Risk and Compliance.
   

  

 The FCPS (Finance Change and Production Services) team, which is part of the (GFC) Global Financial Control organization within CFO division, delivers finance projects and technology solutions for the Bank of America (BAC) enterprise and also supports Line of Business (LOB) projects that impact our core finance and general ledger applications. The Finance Change team is responsible for overall program/project management, business analysis and requirements, functional design, testing, organization readiness and deployment activities. The Production Services function ensures all financial accounting \& regulatory reporting systems and applications are operating smoothly from a functional perspective.
   

  

**Job Description\***
 This role is for a Business Analyst resource responsible for documenting detailed business requirements in support of the FCPS delivery of programs/projects in the US, EMEA, APAC and LATAM regulatory reporting groups and general ledger operations. The resource will be responsible for (1\) understanding the Change, (2\) defining and documenting the current state (if applicable) and target state processes and (3\) ensuring collaboration with Technology teams \& Users until implementation of the Change. It requires working closely with the Business Lead/Product Owner, including upstream / downstream Stakeholders and Technology to ensure all aspects of the change are being considered and prioritized when documenting the requirements. The business requirements are the foundation for the design, build, test, operational / organizational readiness, and deployment activities in the life cycle of a project.
   

  

**Responsibilities\***
* Understanding the Regulatory Change and documenting detailed requirements. This includes functional capabilities, workflow needs, business rules, reporting requirements and timelines, etc. Collaborate with the Users \& procure all required sign offs.
* Identifying current state processes and the target state scope, objective and business outcomes of the Program/Project
* Identifying any data sourcing requirements, documenting them and coordinating with relevant Teams
* Understanding the in\-house GRIFFIN \& AXIOM design and documenting functional specifications in conjunction to the business requirements
* Creating high quality JIRAs documenting all critical aspects including business requirements, mapping requirements, acceptance criteria, etc using the BAC enterprise change management templates
* Create process maps or operating model where necessary.
* Walkthrough of the requirements to Technology and participating in the sprint planning along with the Project Manager.
* Collaborating with the test teams to clearly set the expectations from a Quality or User Acceptance Testing perspective.
* Regression before every code release into production.
* Facilitate review sessions with Business, Technology \& Testing Teams where relevant.


**Requirements\***
**Education\***
 Graduate degree in Commerce, Business or Technology.
   

  

 Certifications If Any \- AXIOM / Business Analysis etc.
   

  

**Experience Range\***
 11 to 13\+ years
   

  

**Foundational skills\***
* Experience as a Functional Business Analyst in technology implementation projects, having written Business requirement documents (BRDs)
* Extremely strong Knowledge of EMEA regulatory reports (COREP, Finrep, AnaCredit, ESG etc..) and Strong knowledge of financial concepts
* Ability to understand complex business processes and breakdown to process components.
* Demonstrate ability to work in a fast\-paced, every\-changing, highly collaborative environment.
* Strong knowledge of creating process maps
* Strong relationship management and interpersonal skills, ability to build strong rapport, respect and trust with key stakeholders and constituents.
* Professional written and verbal communication skills
* Excellent analytical skills and ability to identify/raise questions, and problem\-solving capabilities.
* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail, and good with numbers
* Proficient with Microsoft Office products (particularly MS Excel, Word, Visio, PowerPoint)


**Desired Skills**
* Exposure to projects in Financial Accounting and reporting (in Financial Control / Product Control/Treasury), and/or in Risk Regulatory reporting (Market or Counterparty risk) in financial services industry
* Expertise in Axiom Regulatory platform (if possible, AXIOM certified)
* Knowledge of Banking and Capital market products
* Understanding of automation tools like Alteryx, Tableau, Power BI
* Knowledge/ Experience with Copilot/ Other AI tools usage in day\-to\-day BAU processes
* SQL, Database knowledge \& ability to analyze data and related flows
* Knowledge of Agile methodology and tools (i.e., JIRA)


**Work Timings\***
 11:30 am to 8:30 pm
   

  

**Job Location\***
 Gurugram/Mumbai

title: Assistant Manager - Training
description:
Role: Training
 



 Level: Assistant Manager
 



 Location: Gurugram
 



 Reporting To: Senior Manager \- Training
 



  





**About The Function** 




  





 MakeMyTrip’s Hotels business is one of the
 **largest and fastest\-growing verticals** 
 within the organization, offering a diverse portfolio of accommodations across domestic and international destinations. With a network of
 **70,000\+ contracted properties** 
 , the business spans everything from budget\-friendly stays to premium and experiential hotels, catering to a wide range of traveller needs and serving millions of customers each year.
 



  





 Within this business, the
 **Training team** 
 serves as a key enabler of scale and execution. The team drives capability building across stakeholders by strengthening product understanding, process excellence, service quality, and platform adoption. Through structured learning interventions and continuous upskilling, the Training function helps translate business priorities into consistent on\-ground execution and improved customer outcomes across the Hotels ecosystem.
 



  





**About The Role** 




  





 The role is responsible for end\-to\-end training management and content creation for the Hotels business, combining Learning \& Development, content development, and marketing communication to enable internal teams and partner ecosystems.
 



  





 It involves designing and delivering effective training programs alongside creating engaging communication and learning assets that drive awareness, adoption, and capability building. With a strong focus on clarity, engagement, and scale, the role translates business priorities into structured learning interventions and impactful communication that support consistent execution and performance across the Hotels ecosystem.

* **Training Program Design \& Execution**



 Design and deliver structured skill development programs, role\-based trainings, refresher sessions, and continuous learning interventions aligned with evolving business needs and priorities.
 



  




* **Content Development**



 Develop high\-impact learning content including presentations, facilitator guides, videos, e\-learning modules, promotional videos, and job aids that support effective knowledge transfer and adoption.
 



  




* **Communication Design \& Campaign Management**



 Own end\-to\-end creation of partner\-facing communication assets such as emails, flyers, banners, videos, and digital creatives aligned to business objectives. Plan and execute multi\-channel communication campaigns to support product launches and key initiatives.
 



  




* **Learning Communication \& Enablement**



 Create learning\-focused communication and marketing assets including newsletters, launch decks, mailers, videos, FAQs, and playbooks to reinforce training programs and enable consistent execution.
 



  




* **Training Facilitation**



 Deliver engaging classroom, virtual, and hybrid training sessions for internal teams and external stakeholders, ensuring high levels of participation, clarity, and impact.
 



  




* **Community \& Engagement Management**



 Build and manage internal and external learning communities or social platforms to drive engagement, continuous learning, and knowledge sharing.
 



  




* **Cross\-Functional Collaboration**



 Partner closely with business, sales, operations, product, and HR teams to identify capability gaps and design targeted learning and enablement interventions.
 



  




* **Training Effectiveness \& Continuous Improvement**



 Track training effectiveness through feedback, assessments, and performance metrics, using insights to continuously refine content, delivery, and overall learning outcomes.
 



  





**Qualification \& Experience** 




  




* Management graduate from a reputed institute with 4–6 years of experience across training, learning \& development, content creation, and communication roles.
* Exposure to sales, operations, partner enablement, or capability development environments preferred.
* Experience in e\-commerce, internet, FMCG, hospitality, or service\-oriented organizations is an added advantage.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to create clear, engaging, and audience\-relevant content.
* Hands\-on experience with content creation tools, presentations, and digital learning platforms.
* Working knowledge of social media platforms and digital content best practices preferred



  





**Key Success Factors Of The Role** 




  




* Ability to translate business needs into
 **practical, effective training and communication solutions.**
* High level of
 **ownership and accountability** 
 , with the ability to operate independently and drive outcomes end to end.
* Strong
 **storytelling and content design** 
 capability, with a sharp eye for clarity, engagement, and impact.
* Effective
 **stakeholder management and cross\-functional collaboration** 
 skills across business and support teams.
* **Creative mindset** 
 balanced with structured thinking and disciplined execution.
* Agility to thrive in a
 **fast\-paced environment** 
 while managing multiple priorities simultaneously.

title: CRO Lead
description:
**OneMetric \| Full\-time \| Gurgaon**
****The role in one line****
 This is not a "manage the website" role or a CRO role for its own sake — it's a lead\-generation role that uses the website as the primary lever. You own the website end to end — from a raw idea for a page to a shipped, converting landing page — against one defined outcome: 35–50 MQLs a month generated organically from the website and the motions around it.
   

  

****Why this role exists****
 Most people who "manage the website" either write copy and hand it to a designer, or build pages and wait for someone else to tell them what to put on them. We need someone who does both halves in one head: knows what a page needs to say because they've done the research and talked to customers, and knows why a page converts or doesn't because they think like a CRO person, not just a writer or a builder. The output is a live, working page — not a doc that someone else has to translate.
   

  

******What You'll Own******
* The website as a whole — structure, page inventory, and how it evolves as the company's positioning evolves.
* Idea → live page. You take a rough brief ("we need a page for X service" or "we're repositioning around Y") and turn it into a wireframe, then real copy, then a shipped page — working with a designer where needed, but driving the thing yourself.
* Conversion performance — what's converting, what isn't, and why. You run the experiments, not just report the numbers.
* Lead capture and funnel logic on\-site — forms, CTAs, gating, the path from a visitor landing on a page to becoming a lead in HubSpot.
* The lead number. 35–50 organic leads/month from the website and the motions around it (SEO, AEO, on\-site conversion, content) is your number. The page isn't done when it ships — it's done when it's producing.


****What you'll actually do, week to week****
* Talk to customers and internal stakeholders (sales, delivery, leadership) to figure out what a page actually needs to say to move a buyer — not guess at it from a template.
* Look at signals — search intent, competitor positioning, what prospects ask sales, what's converting elsewhere — and turn them into a point of view on what the page should be.
* Write the copy yourself. This isn't a hand\-off role — strong, clear, buyer\-facing writing is a core skill here, not a nice\-to\-have.
* Sketch wireframes and work directly with a designer (or design tools yourself) to get from idea to a real, live example fast.
* Build and manage pages in WordPress and HubSpot CMS.
* Use AI tools (Claude and others) and Figma as part of your everyday workflow — for research, drafting, quick mockups, and design iteration.
* Structure pages and content for both traditional SEO and AEO (answer engine optimization) — so the site shows up in Google and gets cited by AI answer engines like ChatGPT, Perplexity, and AI Overviews.
* Track what's converting and what's not, and keep iterating rather than treating a page as "done" once it ships.


****What we need****
* A CRO brain. You should be able to look at a page and say, with reasons, why it will or won't convert — and know how to fix it. This means understanding funnels, lead capture mechanics, and what actually moves a B2B buyer to act.
* Strong writing, in service of strategy. You can write clean, persuasive copy, but more importantly you know what needs to be said and why, before you write a word.
* A founder/CMO\-level eye for B2B design. You don't need to be the designer, but you need the taste to know what good B2B design looks like and the ability to brief and push back on one.
* The ability to simplify. You can take a genuinely complex service or technical concept (a RevOps build, an AI GTM agent) and explain it in language a buyer actually understands.
* A working understanding of AEO and SEO. You know how to structure and write content so it ranks in search and gets picked up and cited by AI answer engines (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews) — this isn't optional anymore for a website role.
* Strong writing skills paired with AI fluency. You write well yourself, and you use AI tools to move fast — generating quick mockups, drafts, and iterations rather than waiting on a full design cycle for every idea.
* Comfort with the tools: WordPress, HubSpot CMS, Figma, and AI tools (Claude and similar) as part of daily work.
* Ownership instinct — you treat the website as yours, not as a queue of tickets from other teams.
* 4–5 years of experience working on websites/landing pages, ideally with direct exposure to conversion work, not just content or design in isolation.


****What's in it for you****
* Ownership, not a task list. We don't hand you a checklist and check boxes. Direction and context get discussed openly, and then the "how" — the wireframe, the copy, the page — is yours to run with.
* A performance\-driven culture. Speed and conversion results define your trajectory here, not tenure or face\-time. Ship fast, see what moves the numbers, and get rewarded for it.
* Access to the top of the market. The pages you build speak to CMOs, VPs of Sales, and founders across the B2B US market — real high\-stakes work, not busywork nobody reads.


****How we'll know this is working****
 Within a quarter: organic leads from the website and its motions are trending toward the 35–50/month range, pages you've shipped are outperforming what existed before on conversion, sales and leadership are coming to you first when a new page or repositioning is needed, and the website stops feeling like a static asset and starts feeling like something that's actively working for the business.
   

  

******Who You'll Work With******
 Reports into growth/marketing leadership at OneMetric, works closely with sales, delivery leads, and a designer (in\-house or external) to take ideas from brief to live page.
   

  

******Who You'll Work With******
 This role reports to the CEO’s office at OneMetric and works closely with sales and delivery leaders on HubSpot implementation, RevOps, and GTM projects.

title: Senior Analyst - BCG Vantage
description:
Who We Are
   

  

 Boston Consulting Group partners with leaders in business and society to tackle their most important challenges and capture their greatest opportunities. BCG was the pioneer in business strategy when it was founded in 1963\. Today, we help clients with total transformation\-inspiring complex change, enabling organizations to grow, building competitive advantage, and driving bottom\-line impact.
   

  

 To succeed, organizations must blend digital and human capabilities. Our diverse, global teams bring deep industry and functional expertise and a range of perspectives to spark change. BCG delivers solutions through leading\-edge management consulting along with technology and design, corporate and digital ventures—and business purpose. We work in a uniquely collaborative model across the firm and throughout all levels of the client organization, generating results that allow our clients to thrive.
   

  

 What You'll Do
   

  

 As a Senior Analyst within BCG's Travel Cities and Infrastructure (TCI) and Capital Projects Excellence (CPEx) Practice Areas (PAs), you will work in a growing global team, delivering value to clients via individual expertise and/or institutionalized tools (digital products, methodologies, knowledge, data, workshops, frameworks, surveys, domain\-specific data, and related expertise, etc.).
   

  

 You will be part of BCG Vantage, a network of experienced consultants who leverage deep domain expertise to deliver insight for case teams and clients. Vantage members are affiliated with BCG Practice Areas, plugged into the strategic agenda, and build and deploy leading\-edge IP, data, and tools to support that work.
   

  

 You will contribute to cases and proposals by developing relevant analysis and insights for clients, and support business development and go\-to\-market efforts for both PAs through research and marketing analysis as opportunities arise. This includes travel to client sites during staffing assignments to understand requirements and design/develop solutions.
   

  

 You will support cases, business development, and commercialization efforts, working alongside business leaders, through activities such as:
   

  

 Leading process improvement initiatives in Capital Projects.
   

  

 Creating capital portfolio governance strategies.
   

  

 Analyzing and optimizing engineering processes for greater efficiency and quality.
   

  

 Implementing process standardization and continuous improvement methodologies.
   

  

 Collaborating with engineering and construction teams to ensure process alignment with business goals.
   

  

 Monitoring process performance metrics and implementing corrective actions as needed.
   

  

 What You'll Bring
   

  

* 1\-2\+ years of consulting experience in construction, engineering, process improvement or implementation related field strongly preferred, ideally including a role with an EPC, General contractor or Project Management Consultancy (PMC) — e.g., site supervision, procurement review or vendor coordination
* In lieu of consulting experience, 2\+ years minimum relevant industry experience required; 3\-6\+ years of industry experience strongly preferred
* Bachelor's Degree required (advanced degree preferred) in a relevant field such as engineering or industrial management
* Strong experience with construction and engineering process management and improvement, including working knowledge of civil/structural drawings, BOQs, project controls, scheduling and site documentation
* Experience with cost control, scheduling, risk management and field operations
* Analytical and data driven skills
* Fluency in English
* Strong business acumen and problem\-solving capabilities
* Strong written and verbal communication skills


 Who You'll Work With
   

  

 As a SA, you will work face to face with clients and with BCG Project Leaders, Associates and Consultants. In the period between cases, you will collaborate with global topic leads and colleagues across BCG to bring expertise and capabilities to the service of our internal and external clients. Our team is made up a diverse pool of industry experts that allow us to pursue exciting, innovative consulting careers.
   

  

 Additional info
   

  

**YOU'RE GOOD AT**
* Analytical thinking and problem\-solving, particularly related to infrastructure and making capital projects effective and efficient.
* Communicating with case teams and clients team members, in a credible and confident way
* Stakeholder engagement and communication
* Structured yet pragmatic and agile approach to task and project management.
* Organizational tasks and data analysis, with a keen understanding of how to distil data insights and translate them into action.
* Being a proactive team player with effective communication skills, showcasing practical efficiency over theoretical knowledge.
* Working collaboratively and effectively in a group dynamic, in\-person or virtually; proficient in agile ways of working.
* Being flexible and bringing a curious and creative mindset, open to new things and able to propose innovative ideas.
* Navigating complexity and ambiguity


 At BCG, our people and relationships are at the heart of everything we do. We believe that in\-person collaboration plays an important role in our culture, mentorship, and professional development.
   

  

 For this role, you will generally be expected to work from a BCG office or in person with clients on a regular basis (typically around 50% of working time), depending on business needs and in line with local policies and practices.
   

  

 We aim to provide a dynamic and collaborative environment that fosters connection and teamwork
   

  

 Boston Consulting Group is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, age, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity / expression, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected under national, provincial, or local law, where applicable, and those with criminal histories will be considered in a manner consistent with applicable state and local laws.

**Company:** 
 SkillsNCR
 



**Location:** 
 Gurugram
 



**Job Type:** 
 Full\-time \| In\-person
 



**Experience:** 
 Freshers / 0–2 years only
 



**Eligible Degrees:** 
 BCA / MCA / B.Tech / BE or equivalent technology degree
 



  





**About SkillsNCR** 




**SkillsNCR is building practical, industry\-oriented learning programs and technology\-enabled solutions designed to help students and recent graduates become workplace\-ready.** 




**We are looking for a Graduate Trainee – Technology \& Solutions** 
 who can grow with us across technology development, product support, data, AI, databases and technical learning.
 



 This is not purely a teaching role.
 



  





 You will be expected to:
 



**Learn → Build → Test → Support → Explain** 




**You may work on SkillsNCR's internal platforms, student\-facing applications, assessments, automation, data systems, AI\-enabled solutions and technical learning programs.** 




**You are not expected to know everything on Day 1\. We are looking for someone with strong fundamentals, curiosity, ownership and the ability to learn quickly.** 




  





**What You Will Work On** 




**Depending on your strengths and business requirements, you may work across:** 



* SQL and databases
* MySQL / PostgreSQL
* Python
* Data analysis
* Data engineering fundamentals
* Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning
* Generative AI and AI tools
* APIs and integrations
* Cloud platforms
* Git / GitHub
* Excel and data handling
* Automation
* Web applications and internal tools
* Testing and troubleshooting
* Technical support
* Student assessment platforms
* Learning management and technology solutions



 You are not required to be an expert in all these areas.
 



  





**Build \& Technology** 



* Help build and improve SkillsNCR technology solutions.
* Work on internal tools, dashboards, applications and automation.
* Write and maintain SQL queries.
* Work with databases and datasets.
* Build small applications, scripts and utilities.
* Support integrations between systems and APIs.
* Experiment with AI and Generative AI use cases.
* Assist in developing AI\-enabled learning and assessment solutions.
* Contribute to product enhancements and new features.
* Document technical workflows and solutions.



  





**Testing \& Support** 



* Test new features before release.
* Identify bugs and reproduce technical issues.
* Help troubleshoot application, database and user issues.
* Support students, trainers and internal teams when they face technical problems.
* Maintain issue logs and track resolutions.
* Help improve the reliability and usability of SkillsNCR platforms.
* Work with the team to diagnose and resolve technical issues.



  





**Learning \& Training** 




**As your technical capability develops, you may also:** 



* Help students during practical labs.
* Explain SQL, Python, databases, AI and related topics.
* Create exercises and technical assignments.
* Review student projects.
* Conduct demonstrations and practical sessions.
* Support technical assessments.
* Mentor students on projects and problem solving.



 Teaching responsibilities will depend on your strengths and will grow gradually with your technical experience.
 



  





**Who Should Apply** 




**You may be a good fit if you:** 



* Have completed BCA, MCA, B.Tech, BE or an equivalent technology degree.
* Are a fresher or have no more than 2 years of professional experience.
* Have basic programming knowledge.
* Understand the fundamentals of SQL, databases or software development.
* Are interested in Data, AI, Cloud or software technologies.
* Enjoy solving problems.
* Are comfortable learning new tools independently.
* Can communicate clearly in English and Hindi.
* Are comfortable helping others understand technical concepts.
* Are willing to work full\-time from Gurugram.
* Are comfortable working in an early\-stage startup environment.



  





**What We Value More Than Experience** 




**For this role, we care more about what you can learn and build than the number of years you have worked.** 




**We would like to see things such as:** 



* College projects
* Personal projects
* GitHub repositories
* Python projects
* SQL projects
* Websites or applications you have built
* Data analysis projects
* AI / GenAI experiments
* Automation projects
* Hackathons
* Internships
* Technical presentations



  





 Even a small project is valuable if you can explain:
 



**What problem did you solve?** 




**How did you build it?** 




**What went wrong?** 




**How did you fix it?** 




**You Do Not Need to Know Everything** 




  





**We expect Graduate Trainees to learn.** 




**If we give you a technology you have never used before, we want to see whether you can:** 



1. Understand the fundamentals.
2. Research independently.
3. Build a working solution.
4. Test it.
5. Troubleshoot problems.
6. Document what you did.
7. Explain it to someone else.



 That ability is more important to us than knowing every technology listed in this JD.
 



**This Role May Not Be For You If** 



* You have more than 2 years of professional experience.
* You are looking primarily for a remote role.
* You only want a teaching job.
* You only want a software development job with no user interaction.
* You are unwilling to work outside one specific technology.
* You prefer theory over hands\-on work.
* You are uncomfortable troubleshooting problems.
* You need detailed instructions for every task.
* You are interested mainly in collecting certifications.



  





**Why Join SkillsNCR** 




**As an early member of the team, you may get exposure to multiple areas instead of being limited to one narrow technology.** 




**You could work on:** 



* Data and databases
* AI and Generative AI
* Internal software platforms
* Student applications
* Automation
* Assessments
* Analytics
* Product testing
* Technical support
* Learning content
* Technical mentoring



 You will get an opportunity to understand how a technology solution is designed, built, tested, supported and used by real learners and internal teams.
 



  





 Strong performers can gradually move towards roles such as:
 



**Software / Technology Associate \| Data Analyst \| AI Associate \| Solution Engineer \| Product Support Engineer \| Technical Trainer \| Technology Mentor** 




**What Matters Most** 




**We are looking for graduates who can become dependable problem solvers.** 




**Our expectation is simple:** 




**Learn it. Build it. Test it. Fix it. Explain it.** 




**If that sounds like the kind of career you want to build, we would like to hear from you.** 




  





**Applications are open only to fresh graduates and candidates with 0–2 years of experience.** 




**Show us what you can build, solve and learn — not just what you have studied.**

description:
**About GoKwik**
 GoKwik is a growth operating system designed to power D2C and eCommerce brands — from checkout optimization and reducing return\-to\-origin (RTO), to payments, retention, and post\-purchase engagement. Today, GoKwik enables over 12,000 merchants worldwide, processes around $2 billion in GMV, and is strengthening its AI\-powered infrastructure.
   

  

 Backed by RTP Global, Z47, Peak XV, and Think Investments and bolstered by a $13 million growth round in June 2025 (total funding: $68 million), GoKwik is scaling aggressively across India, the UK, Europe, and the US.
   

  

**Why This Role Matters**
 As GoKwik continues to expand its eCommerce enablement stack, the Implementation team plays a key role in onboarding, enabling, and empowering our merchant partners. This role is at the intersection of product, engineering, and merchant success — responsible for gathering requirements, implementing SaaS solutions, and supporting merchants with integration and product adoption. You’ll be the tech enabler who ensures merchants derive maximum value from GoKwik’s solutions.
   

  

**What You’ll Own**
**Product Implementation \& Integration**
* Collaborate with D2C merchants to gather requirements and create detailed Business Requirement Documents (BRDs)
* Implement GoKwik’s SaaS products across platforms like Shopify, WooCommerce, and Magento
* Support integration via APIs, SDKs, and ensure smooth onboarding and go\-live


**Technical Customer Support**
* Serve as the technical point of contact for merchant teams during and post\-integration
* Troubleshoot implementation issues across web, iOS, and Android
* Assist with tagging tools (Google Ads, Facebook Pixels) and other analytics integrations


**Internal Collaboration \& Feedback Loops**
* Coordinate with product, engineering, and customer success teams to improve merchant experience
* Share feedback and insights to drive product improvements and scalable processes
* Manage multiple merchant projects and prioritize work to meet business timelines


**Merchant Experience \& Enablement**
* Deliver prompt and clear communication to technical and non\-technical stakeholders
* Ensure merchants are set up for long\-term success with GoKwik’s suite of products
* Monitor implementation milestones, escalate roadblocks, and ensure timely delivery


**Who You Are**
* Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science or a related field
* 3\+ years of experience in a client\-facing Implementation Engineer or Integration Support role
* Hands\-on experience with Shopify, WooCommerce, Magento integrations
* Strong understanding of APIs, SDKs, and web technologies (HTML, CSS, JavaScript)
* Familiarity with ad tech tools like Google Ads and Facebook Pixel
* Excellent communication skills with the ability to collaborate across technical and non\-technical teams
* Strong multitasking and project management skills


**Why GoKwik**
 At GoKwik, you're not just building tech — you're building the future of eCommerce. We work fast, solve real\-world problems, and obsess over merchant success. Our culture values speed, ownership, and continuous innovation. If you thrive in high\-growth environments, love collaborating with smart, driven people, and want to be part of a mission\-driven team, we’d love to meet you.

title: Senior Cash Transfer Analyst
description:
**Job Description:** 




 IPE Global Limited invites applications from eligible candidates for the position of
 **Senior Cash Transfer Analyst** 
 to support the strengthening and implementation of the Cash Transfer Scheme.
 



 The position will provide programmatic, analytical, and coordination support to improve the implementation, monitoring, and governance of the schemes. The Analyst will work closely with the national team, technical partners, project state teams, and other key stakeholders.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities**




**1\. Programme Monitoring \& Implementation Support** 



* Support the national team in monitoring the implementation of the Scheme across various states. Track programme performance, enrolment, approvals, benefit disbursement, pendency and key implementation indicators.
* Support development and revision of implementation strategies, SOPs, advisories, operational tools and review formats. Support development and revision of implementation strategies, SOPs, advisories, operational tools and review formats.
* Identify implementation bottlenecks and support coordination with the national and the state teams.



**2\. Data Management \& Analysis** 



* Compile, clean and analyse programme data and other relevant datasets to generate actionable insights.
* Conduct trend analysis to identify coverage gaps, operational issues and high\-priority geographies.
* Prepare dashboards, presentations and analytical summaries for reviews and decision\-making.
* Support periodic data validation and quality improvement exercises.



  





**3\. Government Engagement \& Programme Strengthening** 



* Coordinate with various Government stakeholders and other partners on programme implementation issues.
* Support national review meetings, consultations, workshops and capacity\-building initiatives.
* Follow up on action points emerging from reviews and ensure timely reporting by teams.



  





**4\. Documentation \& Knowledge Management** 



* Prepare monthly, quarterly and ad\-hoc reports, briefing notes and presentations.
* Document implementation challenges, best practices, innovations and success stories from the project states.
* Support preparation of policy notes, concept notes and technical documents.



  





**5\. Capacity Building \& Technical Assistance** 



* Support development of training materials, user guides and communication resources related to various Cash Transfer Schemes.
* Provide technical support to project states on scheme processes , MIS functionality and reporting requirements.
* Coordinate with technical team to address system\-related issues and improve user adoption.



  





 As job descriptions cannot be exhaustive, the Cash Transfer Analyst may be required to undertake other duties as determined by the Cash Transfer Expert that are broadly in line with the above key responsibilities.
 



  





**Qualification \& Experience:** 




**Essential**



* Postgraduate degree in Public Policy, Economics, Public Administration, Social Sciences, Management, Statistics or a related field.
* 5\-8 years of experience supporting Government of India programmes, preferably in DBT, social protection, health or nutrition.
* Strong analytical skills with experience in Excel and presentation development; familiarity with MIS data analysis.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.



  





**Desirable**



* Experience working on national cash transfer schemes or social protection programmes.
* Knowledge of DBT, PFMS and government programme implementation processes.

title: Analyst - Flight Operations Safety Reporting and Insights
description:
Achieving our goals starts with supporting yours. Grow your career, access top\-tier health and wellness benefits, build lasting connections with your team and our customers, and travel the world using our extensive route network.

* Support adoption of advanced analytics, AI\-enabled solutions, and data\-driven decision\-making practices across Flight Operations

* Master's and above in Physics, Chemistry or Medicine.

title: Senior Consultant- Project Management
description:
Project Management Office Senior Analyst
   

  

 Ready to grow your project management career? Join ERM, a global leader in sustainability consulting, and play a key role in supporting impactful projects that shape a better future. If you’re detail\-oriented, thrive in dynamic environments, and enjoy collaborating with top\-tier professionals, this is your opportunity to make a difference.
   

  

 Why This Role Matters
   

  

 As an PMO Senior Analyst you’ll provide critical support to Project Managers, ensuring smooth execution across all project phases. Your work will help maintain timelines, budgets, and quality standards—directly contributing to client satisfaction and ERM’s reputation for excellence.
   

  

 What Your Impact Is
   

  

* Assist with project coordination from proposal through closure, ensuring tasks are completed on time and within scope.
* Maintain project documentation, trackers, and dashboards for accurate reporting.
* Support financial processes, including invoicing schedules, accruals, and cost tracking.
* Facilitate meeting logistics, prepare agendas/minutes, and follow up on action items.
* Help enforce health, safety, and compliance standards across project activities.
* Collaborate with internal teams and subcontractors to keep deliverables on track.


 What You’ll Bring
   

  

**Required**
* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Environmental Science, Business, or related field (or equivalent experience).
* 7\+ years of experience in project coordination or project management support.
* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite and ability to learn project management tools.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills; ability to work in a fast\-paced environment.


**Preferred**
* Experience in environmental consulting, engineering, or sustainability projects.
* Familiarity with financial tracking, invoicing, and subcontractor coordination.
* Exposure to cost estimation tools and project governance processes.
* Certifications such as CAPM or progress toward PMP.


 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Proposal Phase: Assist with subcontractor vetting, cost estimate preparation, and project plan development.
* Contract Phase: Organize documentation, support project setup, and ensure governance requirements are met.
* Start\-Up Phase: Coordinate kick\-off meetings, invoicing schedules, and health \& safety documentation.
* Implementation Phase: Track progress, update schedules, monitor scope changes, and maintain risk/issue logs.
* Delivery \& Closure: Support technical reviews, ensure timely deliverable submission, and assist with invoicing and collections.


 Why You’ll Love Working Here
   

  

 ERM offers a collaborative culture, professional development opportunities, and the chance to work on projects that make a real impact on sustainability and the environment.

title: Senior Proposal Manager

-

* Graduate/post\-graduate from top\-tier institutes with strong academic background. An academic background in economics / development studies / sociology / social work and other allied streams will be a positive but is not essential.

title: Trainer - Ortho Robotics - MISSO
description:
Open Locations \-
 



**Delhi, Cochin and Vapi** 




  





 The
 **Trainer – MISSO Orthopedic Robotics** 
 will be responsible for designing, developing, and delivering comprehensive training programs for surgeons, clinical teams, hospital staff, and internal employees on the MISSO Orthopedic Robotic System. The role aims to enhance clinical proficiency, ensure effective adoption of the robotic platform, and build strong product and procedural capabilities across customer and internal teams.
 



  





***Key Responsibilities***




  





***1\. Training Program Design \& Delivery***




*· Develop and deliver structured training programs on the MISSO Orthopedic Robotic System for surgeons, OT staff, and hospital teams.* 




*· Conduct procedure\-specific training covering robot\-assisted orthopedic procedures, particularly knee replacement workflows.* 




*· Deliver hands\-on, simulation\-based, classroom, and virtual training programs for different learner groups.* 




*· Conduct Train\-the\-Trainer programs for internal TAS and Clinical Applications teams to ensure consistent knowledge transfer.* 




*· Provide on\-site training and clinical support during initial procedures and customer onboarding.* 




  





***2\. Internal Employee Training***




*· Conduct product, application, and procedural training for TAS, Service Engineers, and other relevant internal teams.* 




*· Develop structured learning modules to improve product knowledge, clinical understanding, and field readiness.* 




*· Assess employee competency through practical evaluations, simulations, and knowledge assessments.* 




*· Identify capability gaps and conduct refresher and advanced training programs as required.* 




*· Support onboarding and continuous development programs for new MISSO team members.* 




  





***3\. Content Development \& Training Innovation***




*· Develop and maintain training materials, presentations, procedure guides, simulations, and assessment modules.* 




*· Create practical and easy\-to\-understand learning content covering system workflow, surgical planning, robotic application, instrumentation, and troubleshooting.* 




*· Continuously update training content based on product enhancements, field feedback, customer requirements, and clinical developments.* 




*· Introduce interactive and simulation\-based learning methods to improve trainee engagement and competency.* 




  





***4\. Customer \& Cross\-functional Collaboration***




*· Work closely with Clinical Applications, Service, Sales, Product, and Marketing teams to ensure effective customer training and product adoption.* 




*· Coordinate with surgeons and hospital stakeholders to understand training requirements and develop appropriate learning interventions.* 




*· Support customer onboarding and ensure users achieve required competency before independent system utilization.* 




*· Gather customer and field feedback and incorporate relevant insights into future training programs.* 




  





***5\. Measurement \& Evaluation***




*· Conduct Training Needs Analysis (TNA) for customers and internal teams to identify competency and knowledge gaps.* 




*· Evaluate training effectiveness through assessments, practical demonstrations, feedback, and competency evaluations.* 




*· Maintain comprehensive training records, attendance, assessment reports, feedback, and competency trackers.* 




*· Monitor training outcomes and continuously improve training programs based on learner and field feedback.* 




  





***Qualifications \& Experience***




*· Education: Bachelor’s degree in Biomedical Engineering / Life Sciences / Physiotherapy / Nursing / Allied Medical Field. Master’s degree preferred.* 




*· Experience: 3–8 years of experience in clinical applications, customer training, medical devices, orthopedic robotics, surgical navigation, or related medtech domains.* 




*· Experience in orthopedic procedures, knee replacement, robotic\-assisted surgery, or surgical technology will be preferred.* 




*· Prior experience in delivering customer and internal employee training will be an advantage.* 




*· Willingness to travel extensively across India for customer and internal training programs.* 




  





***Key Competencies***




*· Strong understanding of orthopedic surgical workflows and robotic\-assisted procedures.* 




*· Excellent training, facilitation, presentation, and communication skills.* 




*· Strong customer\-facing and stakeholder\-management abilities.* 




*· Ability to conduct effective hands\-on, classroom, and practical training.* 




*· Ability to simplify complex clinical and technical concepts for different audiences.* 




*· Collaborative, adaptable, and field\-oriented professional with a strong learning mindset.*

title: Field Engineer - India
description:
Our mission is to automate coding. The first step in our journey is to build the best tool for professional programmers, using a combination of inventive research, design, and engineering. Our organization is very flat, and our team is small and talent dense. We particularly like people who are truth\-seeking, passionate, and creative. We enjoy spirited debate, crazy ideas, and shipping code.
   

  

****About The Role****
 We’re hiring Field Engineers to partner with prospective and strategic enterprise customers. As a Field Engineer, you’ll be the technical face of Anysphere in the field, helping customers evaluate Cursor, guiding them through proofs of concept, and ensuring they see the full value of AI in their engineering workflows.
   

  

 You’ll work hand\-in\-hand with Sales, Product, and Engineering to scope solutions, demonstrate capabilities, and act as a trusted advisor to technical stakeholders. This is a highly customer\-facing role where you’ll combine deep technical fluency with strong communication skills to drive adoption and influence product direction.
   

  

****What You’ll Do****
* Partner with Account Executives to lead technical discovery, demos, and proof\-of\-concept engagements
* Build trusted relationships with engineering leaders, architects, and developers, serving as their technical advisor
* Translate customer requirements into solution designs, guiding them on best practices for rollout, prompt strategy, and context configuration
* Develop and deliver technical presentations, whiteboard sessions, and hands\-on workshops tailored to customer needs
* Act as the customer’s technical advocate internally, influencing roadmap priorities and escalating feedback to Product and Engineering
* Collaborate with post\-sales teams to ensure a smooth handoff and successful customer onboarding
* Maintain deep knowledge of Cursor’s capabilities and competitive landscape to position our value effectively
* Support strategic account planning and help drive expansion opportunities with technical validation


**You may be a fit if**
* You have strong communication skills and executive presence, equally comfortable coding alongside developers or presenting to CTOs.
* You have a deep understanding of the software development lifecycle, modern engineering org structures, and developer productivity challenges
* You have hands\-on technical ability, and while you don’t need to be a full\-time engineer, but you should be fluent in technical workflows, AI tooling, and debugging complex environments
* You are customer\-obsessed with a knack for translating technical details into business impact
* You have experience in Field Engineering, Solutions Architecture, Pre\-Sales, or Consulting for enterprise software
* You thrive in a startup environment: resourceful, adaptable, and proactive in creating solutions

title: Research Intern :: Gender- Geopolitics
description:
Position: Intern
 



 Location: New Delhi
 



 Employment Type: Internship
 



  





 About the Think Tank: Chintan Research Foundation (CRF) is a nonprofit public policy organization based in New Delhi. We are a dynamic and forward\-thinking research institution committed to advancing innovative solutions for the most pressing global challenges across a diverse set of focus areas. We are dedicated to conducting rigorous research, shaping evidence\-based policies, and fostering thought leadership. We bring together preeminent experts from government and academia worldwide, fostering a culture of open\-minded research and embracing diverse perspectives. Our collective expertise results in the production of top\-tier research, policy guidance, and analytical insights. Our core research areas include programs focused on Climate Change \& Energy Transition, Economy \& Trade and Geopolitics \& Strategic Studies.

It is a dedicated hub examining and addressing the complex world of geopolitics, global strategy, and international relations. The Center of Geopolitics and Strategic Studies is accepting applications for an Intern. The Intern will report directly to the Senior/Associate Fellow of CRF and is expected to conduct in\-depth, high quality public policy research in areas of their expertise; support in publications and engage with stakeholders to promote our events.
 



  





 Key Responsibilities:
 



 • Collect and analyze data from various sources to support research initiatives related to geopolitical and strategic issues.
 



 • Conduct in\-depth research and data analysis on the focus areas.
 



 • Contribute to the creation of research reports, policy papers, and articles of the highest quality and relevance.
 



 • Organize, manage, and document research materials to support ongoing projects.
 



 • Provide logistical and administrative support for events, seminars, and workshops.
 



  





 Qualifications and Skills:
 



 • Master’s degree, preferably in Political Science, International Relations or a similar field with a strong focus on gender \& geopolitics.
 



 • Understanding of global power dynamics, regional conflicts, and international political frameworks
 



 • Strong research and analytical skills with attention to detail.
 



 • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
 



 • Proficiency in data analysis tools and research software.
 



 • Proficiency in MS Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint).
 



 • Ability to work as part of a team as well as on own initiative.
 



 • Ability to work in a fast\-paced environment.
 



 • Strong interpersonal skills and team ethics.

**About The Role**
 We are building an AI\-native product for the legal industry and are looking for a Research, Product Strategy Associate to work directly with the founders across product, research, market intelligence, and strategic initiatives.
   

  

 This is a highly cross\-functional role with a strong focus
 **on understanding and improving the product** 
 . You will research markets and competitors, study how AI and software products work, analyses user and industry needs, and translate your findings into product ideas, strategic recommendations, and structured execution plans.
   

  

 The role is ideal for someone who enjoys diving into unfamiliar subjects, understanding how products and businesses work, experimenting with technology, and turning large amounts of information into clear, actionable insights.
   

  

**What You'll Work On**
* Work closely with the founders on product research, product strategy, feature exploration, and new initiatives.
* Study our product and related workflows to identify product gaps, improvement opportunities, potential features, and new use cases.
* Research AI, legal\-tech, SaaS, and software products to understand their features, workflows, UX, capabilities, positioning, and use cases.
* Conduct research across markets, companies, products, competitors, customers, and emerging technologies.
* Analyze competing AI and legal\-tech products across their business models, customers, pricing, funding, features, and market positioning.
* Build structured research databases, competitor matrices, market maps, feature comparisons, and product analyses.
* Speak to or study potential users and customers to better understand their workflows, pain points, behaviors, and requirements.
* Convert research and user insights into product recommendations, feature ideas, strategic briefs, and actionable next steps.
* Analyze information to identify trends, gaps, opportunities, and strategic insights.
* Experiment extensively with AI tools and emerging technologies to understand how they can be incorporated into the product.
* Create clear presentations, spreadsheets, documents, product notes, and strategic briefs.
* Support the founders on high\-priority projects across product, strategy, market intelligence, and business initiatives.


**What We're Looking For**
* Tech / Engineering graduates with 24 years of experience, or MBA graduates with 02 years of experience.
* Strong interest in product, technology, AI, software, and business strategy.
* Strong research, analytical, and problem\-solving skills.
* Ability to understand software products deeply including their features, workflows, user experience, and underlying use cases.
* Highly proficient with AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Perplexity, and similar platforms , and comfortable using AI extensively in everyday work.
* Ability to independently explore and learn unfamiliar industries, technologies, and products quickly.
* Strong written English and the ability to structure and communicate complex information clearly.
* Comfortable working extensively with spreadsheets, presentations, documents, and research tools.
* Curious, detail\-oriented, resourceful, and comfortable taking ownership of open\-ended assignments.
* Comfortably operating in a fast\-moving environment where priorities may evolve as the product and company grow.


**Who This Role Is Best Suited For**
 You are a strong fit for this role if you naturally enjoy:
   

  

* Exploring new AI software products to understand how they work.
* Comparing different products and analyzing why one product performs better than another.
* Breaking down ambiguous problems and designing research approaches to solve them.
* Identifying product improvements, feature gaps, and better user workflows.
* Using AI tools to research, write, prototype, and solve problems faster.
* Turning scattered information into clear, structured insights.


**Growth Progression**
 As the company grows, this role can evolve into broader ownership across
 **product management, product strategy, business strategy, market intelligence, growth, and other high\-priority initiatives,** 
 depending on the individuals strengths and interests.
   

  

 The role offers significant exposure to 0\-to\-1 product building and the opportunity to work closely with the founders on decisions that directly shape the product and company.

title: Technical Service Specialist-Coatings Solutions
description:
**Technical Service Specialist – Coatings Solutions**
**Location: Multiple Locations Across India**
 Help Customers Transform Performance Through Technical Excellence
   

  

 Are you passionate about coatings technology, customer success, troubleshooting complex technical challenges, and driving continuous improvement?
   

  

 At Axalta, our Technical Service professionals play a critical role in helping customers maximize quality, productivity, and performance. Working at the intersection of technology, innovation, and customer engagement, Technical Service Specialists provide expert support across a wide range of industries, including Automotive OEM, Commercial Vehicles, Industrial Manufacturing, Agricultural Equipment, Construction Equipment, Rail, and Automotive Refinish.
   

  

 This evergreen opportunity is designed to build our pipeline of technical talent for current and future openings across our Mobility, Industrial, and Refinish businesses throughout India.
   

  

 What You'll Do
   

  

 As a Technical Service Specialist, you will serve as a trusted technical advisor to customers, helping them optimize coating processes, resolve technical challenges, and successfully implement new products and technologies.
   

  

 Technical Support \& Customer Success
   

  

* Provide expert technical support for coatings products and application processes.
* Partner closely with customers to improve product performance, quality, and operational efficiency.
* Investigate and resolve product, process, color, and application\-related issues.
* Act as a trusted technical resource for key customer accounts.


 Product Implementation \& Commercialization
   

  

* Support the launch and implementation of new products and technologies at customer facilities.
* Conduct product trials and validation activities in collaboration with Technology and Commercial teams.
* Drive product approvals and specification wins with OEM and industrial customers.
* Support successful commercialization of innovative coating solutions.


 Process Improvement \& Standardization
   

  

* Analyze customer coating processes and identify opportunities for optimization.
* Develop and implement standard operating procedures and best practices.
* Drive process consistency, quality improvements, and productivity enhancements.
* Support continuous improvement initiatives across customer operations.


 Training \& Technical Development
   

  

* Deliver technical training programs for customers, distributors, bodyshops, OEMs, and production teams.
* Conduct audits and process reviews to ensure compliance with recommended application standards.
* Share technical expertise and best practices to improve customer capabilities.


 Project \& Relationship Management
   

  

* Build strong relationships with customers at multiple organizational levels.
* Coordinate cross\-functional projects involving Sales, Technology, Operations, Marketing, and Supply Chain teams.
* Monitor project progress and ensure timely execution of customer initiatives.
* Maintain regular communication regarding technical performance, project milestones, and improvement opportunities.


 Data Analysis \& Reporting
   

  

* Monitor application performance, paint consumption, process data, and quality metrics.
* Analyze technical data and provide recommendations to customers and internal stakeholders.
* Prepare technical reports, findings, and improvement plans.
* Support data\-driven decision making through accurate performance tracking and reporting.


 What We're Looking For
   

  

 Education
   

  

* Ideally Bachelor's Degree in Chemical Engineering, Paint Technology, Chemistry, Materials Science, or a related technical discipline.


**Experience**
* 3\-8 years of experience in technical service, coating applications, manufacturing processes, product development, or related technical\-commercial roles.
* Experience within one or more of the following industries is highly desirable:
+ Coatings and Paints
+ Automotive OEM
+ Commercial Vehicles
+ Automotive Refinish
+ Industrial Manufacturing
+ Agricultural Equipment
+ Construction Equipment
+ Rail Transportation


 Technical Expertise
   

  

* Knowledge of coating technologies, paint formulation, and application processes.
* Understanding of manufacturing and coating line operations.
* Experience supporting product launches, trials, and process improvements.
* Exposure to troubleshooting color, appearance, and application\-related issues.
* Experience working with customers in a technical support environment.


 Professional Skills
   

  

* Strong problem\-solving and analytical capabilities.
* Excellent communication and presentation skills.
* Ability to build trust and credibility with customers.
* Strong project management and organizational skills.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities in a dynamic environment.
* Collaborative approach with the ability to work effectively across cross\-functional teams.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications; CRM experience is an advantage.


**Additional Requirements**
* Customer\-focused mindset with a passion for delivering technical excellence.
* Ability to work independently and travel extensively based on business needs.
* Experience in multicultural and matrix environments is an advantage.


 Why Join Axalta?
   

  

**At Axalta, You'll Have The Opportunity To**
* Work with leading global and regional manufacturers across diverse industries.
* Gain exposure to innovative coatings technologies and advanced manufacturing environments.
* Develop both technical and commercial expertise through challenging customer\-facing projects.
* Collaborate with talented colleagues across Technical, Commercial, Operations, and R\&D functions.
* Build a rewarding career in a company that values innovation, continuous learning, and professional growth.
* Make a direct impact on customer success, product performance, and business growth.


 Join Our Technical Talent Community
   

  

 We are continuously seeking talented technical professionals who are passionate about coatings, manufacturing excellence, and customer success. By applying to this evergreen opportunity, you'll be considered for current and future Technical Service roles across our Mobility, Industrial, and Refinish businesses throughout India.
   

  

**Our Company**
 Axalta has remained at the forefront of the coatings industry by continually investing in innovative solutions. We engineer technologies that protect customers’ products – whether they are battling heat, light, corrosion, abrasion, moisture, or chemicals – and add dimension and beauty with colorful finishes. We have a vast and ever\-evolving portfolio of brands primed to play an important part in everything from modernizing infrastructure around the world to enabling the next generation of electric and autonomous vehicles.
   

  

 Axalta operates its business in two segments: Performance Coatings and Mobility Coatings, which serve four end markets, including Refinish, Industrial, Light Vehicle and Commercial Vehicle, across North America, EMEA, Latin America and Asia\-Pacific. Our diverse global footprint allows us to deliver solutions in over 140\+ countries and coat 30 million vehicles per year. We’ve recently set an exciting 2040 carbon neutrality goal, in addition to 10 other sustainability initiatives, and we take pride in working with our customers to optimize their businesses and achieve their goals.
   

  

 Axalta may use technology\-assisted tools, including artificial intelligence (AI), to support certain aspects of the recruitment and selection process. These tools may be used to help manage applications, identify job\-related qualifications, and assist recruiter review. All hiring decisions involve human oversight and review.
   

  

**Recruitment Fraud Alert** 
 : We take candidate safety seriously. If you believe you’ve encountered a fraudulent job posting claiming to represent our company, please include a link or screenshot and report it to TA\-Support\-Center@axalta.com.
   

  

 We consider an individual’s qualifications, skillset, and experience to determine final salary. This role is eligible for benefits such as health insurance and paid time off. The actual offer will be at the company’s sole discretion and determined by relevant business considerations, including the final candidate’s qualifications, years of experience, skillset, and geographic location.
   

  

 While this position is not currently open, we are building a talent pool for future opportunities and will keep your resume on file.

 R\&D, Product Lifecycle Management, Commercial Awareness, Business Partnership, Collaboration, Partnership building, Collaborator, Ability to challenge the status quo, Propose improvement, Accountability, Adaptability, Analytical, Formulation, Science, Chemistry.

 Equality
